en: to fail to notice or consider something
example: We often overlook small mistakes when we are in a hurry.
exampleZh: 我们匆忙时常常忽略小错误。

zh: 亲切私密的；小而温馨的
en: small, private and warm in feeling
example: They had dinner in an intimate restaurant with only six tables.
exampleZh: 他们在一家只有六张桌子的温馨小餐馆吃了晚饭。

en: the relationship between two amounts
example: Mix the rice and water in a ratio of one to two.
exampleZh: 按一比二的比例把米和水混合。

en: a set of actions always done in the same way
example: Making tea is part of my morning ritual.
exampleZh: 泡茶是我早晨固定程序的一部分。

en: able to attract iron or steel
example: The magnetic strip on the wall holds all our kitchen knives.
exampleZh: 墙上的磁性条吸住了我们所有的厨房刀。

en: careful and detailed examination

exampleZh: 这些账目受到了委员会的仔细审查。

en: really and sincerely

exampleZh: 见到老同学，她打心底里高兴。

en: extremely impressive to see
example: The view from the top of the hill was spectacular.
exampleZh: 从山顶望去的景色非常壮观。

en: not large or expensive; simple

exampleZh: 他们住在车站附近一套不大的公寓里。

en: a long passage inside a building
example: Students waited quietly in the corridor outside the exam room.
exampleZh: 学生们在考场外的走廊里安静地等候。

en: a very thin line of something

exampleZh: 一根细细的红棉线挂在了钉子上。

en: a person who receives help or money from something
example: The main beneficiary of the new park was the local children.
exampleZh: 新公园最大的受益者是当地的孩子。

en: to encourage something to grow or happen

exampleZh: 鲜艳的海报能激发孩子们的阅读兴趣。

en: to show something new to the public for the first time
example: The school will unveil its new library next Monday.
exampleZh: 学校将于下周一为新图书馆揭幕。

en: the purpose or benefit of something
example: For the sake of her health, he quit smoking.
exampleZh: 为了她的健康，他戒了烟。

en: the act of keeping something in its original state

exampleZh: 保护老建筑要花费大量金钱。

en: holy and deserving deep respect
example: The old temple is a sacred place for local families.
exampleZh: 这座古庙对当地家庭来说是神圣之地。

en: attracting a lot of public attention

exampleZh: 这场审判成了全国都在关注的高调案件。

en: having a mistake or weakness

exampleZh: 他们的方案有缺陷，因为忽略了维修成本。

en: to force someone to do something

exampleZh: 恶劣天气迫使球队取消了比赛。

en: to give someone the power to do something

exampleZh: 这个培训项目帮助女性有能力自己创业。

en: a system in which people take turns

exampleZh: 护士们轮流工作，每次四小时。

en: the sale of a public service to private owners

exampleZh: 公交公司私有化让许多乘客的车费上涨。

en: to guess about something without firm evidence

exampleZh: 记者们猜测她突然辞职的原因。

en: the duty to explain and answer for one's actions

exampleZh: 选民要求市议会承担更多责任。

en: someone who shows strong public disagreement

exampleZh: 一名抗议者在工厂大门外举着牌子。

en: the process of taking in something such as complaints

exampleZh: 这个办公室每天大约接收五十通电话。

en: permission for something to happen

exampleZh: 未经业主同意，这笔出售不能进行。

en: to stop happening or doing something

exampleZh: 雨在午夜前后终于停了。

en: the act of fitting equipment in place

exampleZh: 新灯的安装花了两天时间。

en: a wish to hurt or annoy someone

exampleZh: 他那么说是出于恶意，并不是因为那是真的。

en: used to emphasize that something is complete

exampleZh: 我们能找到钥匙纯属运气。

exampleZh: 唱诗班进场时，会众站了起来。

en: an official document that proves something

exampleZh: 她把证书装进相框，挂在办公室里。

en: the crime of cheating people for money

exampleZh: 审计之后，他因欺诈被捕。

en: official papers that prove or record something

exampleZh: 请携带能证明你住址的文件。

en: a senior Christian priest of high rank

exampleZh: 主教星期一上午参观了这所学校。

en: to hit something lightly and quickly

exampleZh: 他轻敲玻璃以引起她的注意。

en: soon; in a short time

exampleZh: 医生很快就会给你看诊，请在这里等候。

en: a holiday on a ship that visits places

exampleZh: 他们沿着挪威海岸乘船游览。

en: the act of changing something into another form

exampleZh: 把谷仓改造成住宅花了一年时间。

en: a person kept in a prison

exampleZh: 那名囚犯每天晚上在牢房里学习。

en: to match or agree with something

exampleZh: 他的说法与事实不符。

en: a doctor of medicine

exampleZh: 她的医生让她休息一周。

en: a journalist who writes a regular column

exampleZh: 这位专栏作家每周日写政治评论。

en: to reach an opinion from evidence

exampleZh: 我们可以从数据推断出销量正在下降。

exampleZh: 她是那起事故唯一的目击者。

en: extremely angry

exampleZh: 航班被取消时，他非常愤怒。

en: to help something grow or develop

exampleZh: 好老师会培养学生的好奇心。

en: brave and confident; not afraid of risk

exampleZh: 自己创业对她来说是个大胆的举动。

en: a share or interest in something
example: The company has a large stake in the new port project.
exampleZh: 这家公司在新港口项目中持有大量股份。

en: angry or violent behaviour towards others
example: The referee warned him about his aggression.
exampleZh: 裁判就他的攻击性行为警告了他。

en: to watch over and direct work or people
example: A nurse must supervise the trainees at all times.
exampleZh: 护士必须始终监督受训人员。

en: the land along the edge of a sea or lake
example: We walked along the shore after dinner.
exampleZh: 晚饭后我们沿着海岸散步。

en: serious discussion or writing about a subject

exampleZh: 她的书对现代教育作了细致的论述。

en: shared by all members of a group

exampleZh: 这个花园是全街人共同努力的成果。

en: a secret vote, or the paper used for it
example: Members chose the new chair by secret ballot.
exampleZh: 成员们通过无记名投票选出了新主席。

en: a container on wheels pulled by a vehicle
example: They loaded the broken chairs onto a trailer.
exampleZh: 他们把坏掉的椅子装上了一辆拖车。

en: pieces left after something is destroyed

exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，整片海滩都覆盖着残骸。

en: the setting a device uses unless you change it

exampleZh: 这台打印机的默认设置是双面打印。

en: a mixture of different things
example: This tea is a blend of three mountain herbs.
exampleZh: 这种茶是三种山草药的混合物。

en: a strong feeling of anger and shock

exampleZh: 关闭图书馆的决定引起了公众的愤怒。

en: to clean or remove something with a cloth
example: He wiped the dust from the old mirror.
exampleZh: 他擦掉了旧镜子上的灰尘。

en: the remains of an ancient plant or animal in rock
example: The children found a fossil in the cliff.
exampleZh: 孩子们在悬崖上发现了一块化石。

en: likely or willing to do something
example: She is inclined to agree with the new plan.
exampleZh: 她倾向于同意这个新方案。

en: existing as a natural part of something
example: Every sport carries an inherent risk of injury.
exampleZh: 每项运动都带有受伤的固有风险。

en: a large place used for sports or shows
example: The concert filled the new arena in minutes.
exampleZh: 音乐会几分钟内就坐满了新场馆。

en: the natural home of an animal or plant
example: The wetland is an important habitat for birds.
exampleZh: 这片湿地是鸟类的重要栖息地。

en: as it appears, though perhaps not truly
example: The street was seemingly quiet after the festival.
exampleZh: 节庆过后，街上看似安静了下来。

en: to give or find time or money for something
example: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
exampleZh: 你能抽出几分钟帮我一下吗？

en: the work of protecting nature or old things
example: She works for a wildlife conservation group.
exampleZh: 她在一个野生动物保护组织工作。

en: a complete change in form or character
example: The old factory underwent a surprising transformation.
exampleZh: 那座旧工厂经历了令人惊讶的转变。

en: a boy or young man
example: The lad carried the heavy box upstairs for us.
exampleZh: 那个小伙子帮我们把重箱子搬上了楼。

en: to be a clear example of an idea or quality
example: These old songs embody the hopes of a whole generation.
exampleZh: 这些老歌体现了一整代人的希望。

en: to step in to change what is happening
example: The teacher intervened before the argument grew worse.
exampleZh: 老师介入，避免争吵进一步恶化。

en: popular music, or songs of this style
example: She listens to pop while doing her homework.
exampleZh: 她一边写作业一边听流行音乐。

en: a person who drives a car
example: A motorist stopped to help us change the tire.
exampleZh: 一位驾车者停下来帮我们换轮胎。

en: a careful judgment about something's good and bad points
example: The article offers a fair critique of the new policy.
exampleZh: 这篇文章对新政策作了公正的评论。

en: to give official permission for something
example: The city authorized the repair of the old bridge.
exampleZh: 市政府批准了这座旧桥的维修。

en: kept in addition for use when needed
example: There is a spare key under the flower pot.
exampleZh: 花盆下面有一把备用钥匙。

en: to criticize something publicly and strongly
example: Residents denounced the plan to close the clinic.
exampleZh: 居民们谴责关闭诊所的计划。

en: to make a copy of something
example: The machine can reproduce the painting in great detail.
exampleZh: 这台机器能非常精细地复制这幅画。

en: the act of putting a plan or system into effect
example: The implementation of the new timetable will begin in September.
exampleZh: 新时间表的实施将于九月开始。

en: to make people obey a rule or law
example: Teachers enforce the no-phone rule during exams.
exampleZh: 考试期间老师执行禁止使用手机的规定。

en: connected with sports
example: The school has excellent sporting facilities.
exampleZh: 这所学校有极好的体育设施。

en: an official record of a student's grades
example: She sent her transcript to three universities.
exampleZh: 她把成绩单寄给了三所大学。

en: to get involved in a way that causes trouble
example: Please do not interfere with the machine while it is running.
exampleZh: 机器运转时请不要干扰它。

en: the scenery or situation behind something
example: The mountains formed a beautiful backdrop to the wedding.
exampleZh: 群山为婚礼构成了美丽的背景。

en: great pain, sadness or worry
example: The lost dog caused great distress to the whole family.
exampleZh: 走失的狗让全家十分痛苦。

en: a person who breaks a rule or law
example: The young offender was ordered to do community service.
exampleZh: 这名年轻的违法者被判处做社区服务。

en: easy to see or well known
example: A prominent tower stands at the centre of the old town.
exampleZh: 老城中心矗立着一座显眼的塔楼。

en: to refuse to obey a person or authority
example: Some neighbours rebel against every change the council proposes.
exampleZh: 一些邻居反对议会提出的每一项改变。

en: the act of opposing or fighting something
example: The plan met with strong resistance from local shop owners.
exampleZh: 这个计划遭到当地店主的强烈反对。

en: to take a photograph quickly
example: Tourists snap photos of the old bridge every summer.
exampleZh: 每年夏天游客都会给这座老桥拍照。

en: a serious disagreement
example: The two families settled their dispute over the land.
exampleZh: 两家人解决了关于这块土地的纠纷。

en: to try very hard to achieve something
example: Small businesses strive to keep their prices low.
exampleZh: 小企业努力保持低价。

en: a fast internet connection that carries a lot of data
example: Rural schools still wait for reliable broadband.
exampleZh: 乡村学校仍在等待可靠的宽带。

en: combining parts into one whole system
example: The city has an integrated transport network.
exampleZh: 这座城市有综合的交通网络。

en: very small in amount or importance
example: The change made only a marginal difference to costs.
exampleZh: 这一变化对成本只有微小的影响。

en: to give someone or something a name
example: Critics dubbed the film a modern classic.
exampleZh: 评论家把这部电影称为现代经典。

en: to get something back
example: She hopes to regain her confidence after the accident.
exampleZh: 她希望在事故后重新获得信心。

en: complete and not damaged
example: The old letters were found intact in a wooden box.
exampleZh: 那些旧信件在一个木箱里被发现，完好无损。

en: a handwritten or unpublished text
example: The museum bought the poet's manuscript at auction.
exampleZh: 博物馆在拍卖会上买下了这位诗人的手稿。

en: very clear and often harsh
example: The report shows a stark difference between rich and poor schools.
exampleZh: 报告显示富裕学校与贫困学校之间存在鲜明差距。

en: a state of being unable to stop thinking about something
example: His obsession with old cars fills the whole garage.
exampleZh: 他对旧汽车的痴迷占满了整个车库。

en: to win or be common in the end
example: Common sense finally prevailed in the discussion.
exampleZh: 常理最终在讨论中占了上风。

en: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
example: Many families find it hard to cope with rising bills.
exampleZh: 许多家庭发现难以应付不断上涨的账单。

en: an object or collection shown in a museum
example: The most popular exhibit is a huge dinosaur skeleton.
exampleZh: 最受欢迎的展品是一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms
example: The lorry carried a tonne of sand to the site.
exampleZh: 卡车把一吨沙子运到了工地。

en: the way something is organized
example: The new set-up lets two people share one desk.
exampleZh: 新的安排让两个人共用一张桌子。

en: a small part of a whole
example: Only a fraction of the students attended the lecture.
exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生参加了讲座。

en: happening after a war
example: The post-war years brought new schools and hospitals.
exampleZh: 战后那些年建起了新的学校和医院。

en: during or suddenly in one night

exampleZh: 那家小店在电影播出后一夜之间出了名。

en: following one after another without a break
example: She won the race for three consecutive years.
exampleZh: 她连续三年赢得这项比赛。

en: a person who works in a mine
example: My grandfather worked as a miner for thirty years.
exampleZh: 我祖父当了三十年矿工。

en: to bring something back to life or activity
example: The festival helped revive the small town's economy.
exampleZh: 这个节日帮助小镇的经济复苏。

en: spread over a wide area in small amounts
example: Books were scattered across the floor of his room.
exampleZh: 书散落在他房间的地板上。

en: a general feeling or opinion
example: Public sentiment turned against the plan after the report.
exampleZh: 报告公布后，公众情绪转而反对该计划。

en: to persuade or cause someone to do something
example: The low price induced many families to buy the car.
exampleZh: 低价促使许多家庭买下了这辆车。

en: a unit for measuring liquid
example: He drinks two litres of water every day.
exampleZh: 他每天喝两升水。

en: the amount by which money spent is more than money received
example: The clinic ran a deficit for the third year.
exampleZh: 这家诊所连续第三年出现赤字。

en: a person hurt or killed in an accident or war
example: The crash caused one casualty and several injuries.
exampleZh: 这场撞车事故造成一人死亡、数人受伤。

en: to accept less than you wanted in order to agree
example: Both sides had to compromise to end the strike.
exampleZh: 双方不得不妥协，以结束罢工。

en: not often
example: He seldom speaks in meetings, but people listen.
exampleZh: 他在会上很少发言，但大家都会听。

en: a small area of still water
example: Ducks swim in the pond behind our house.
exampleZh: 鸭子在我们屋后的池塘里游水。

en: a usual way of doing things that most people accept
example: By convention, the youngest member speaks last.
exampleZh: 按照惯例，最年轻的成员最后发言。

en: placed in a particular position
example: The hotel is situated beside a quiet lake.
exampleZh: 这家酒店位于一个安静的湖边。

en: the process of thinking logically about something
example: Her reasoning was clear and convinced the whole team.
exampleZh: 她的推理清晰，说服了整个团队。

en: much more than is reasonable or necessary
example: The hotel charges excessive prices for a simple breakfast.
exampleZh: 这家酒店一顿简单早餐要价过高。

en: an area of short grass around a house

exampleZh: 他每周六上午修剪草坪。

en: to say that something is caused by a particular thing

exampleZh: 她把自己的成功归因于努力和运气。

en: a heavy duty or worry that is hard to bear

exampleZh: 额外的文书工作成了员工的负担。

en: a thing that exists as a single separate unit

exampleZh: 这两所学校现在作为一个法律实体运营。

en: something that limits what you can do

exampleZh: 时间是这个项目的主要限制。

en: the act of becoming larger

exampleZh: 公司的扩张创造了五十个新工作岗位。

en: a habit or likelihood of behaving in a certain way

en: a church district with its own church

exampleZh: 这个教区每年夏天举办一次集市。

en: letters written or received

exampleZh: 她保存了与银行往来的所有信件。

en: an act of breaking a rule or agreement

exampleZh: 这家公司因明显违反安全规定而被罚款。

en: the process of combining parts into one whole

exampleZh: 新员工融入团队花了几个星期。

en: to force people or things out of their usual place

exampleZh: 不断上涨的租金迫使许多家庭离开了老街区。

en: the person or thing that came before another

exampleZh: 我们的新办公室比原先那间明亮得多。

en: easy to reach or use

exampleZh: 这家博物馆现在方便轮椅使用者进入。

en: a long search for something important

exampleZh: 她为寻求更公平的制度努力了许多年。

en: well known for something bad

exampleZh: 这条街因嘈杂和犯罪而声名狼藉。

en: to be in agreement with something

exampleZh: 我们的计划必须与杂志关注本地内容的定位保持一致。

en: an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with

exampleZh: 争论一小时后，团队达成了共识。

en: a person who watches over work or people

exampleZh: 我的主管要求在周五前交一份简短的计划。

en: to develop a plan or idea carefully

en: making people think seriously about something
example: Her essay on borrowing among neighbours was genuinely thought-provoking.
exampleZh: 她那篇关于邻里间借东西的文章确实发人深省。

en: coming before the main part or event
example: We drew up a preliminary plan before spending any money.
exampleZh: 我们在花钱之前先拟定了一份初步计划。

en: a person who pays to receive a service regularly
example: Each new subscriber receives a short welcome email.
exampleZh: 每位新订阅者都会收到一封简短的欢迎邮件。

en: the work of building something again as it was
example: The reconstruction of the old coaster took five years.
exampleZh: 这艘老货船的重建花了五年时间。

en: goods carried by a ship, plane or truck
example: The vessel carried cargo such as salt and timber.
exampleZh: 这艘船运载盐和木材之类的货物。

en: a group of ships or vehicles owned together
example: The harbour fleet once numbered thirty small fishing boats.
exampleZh: 这个港口的船队曾经有三十条小渔船。

en: the act of setting a place or people free
example: The town still holds a parade on the anniversary of its liberation.
exampleZh: 这座小镇仍在解放纪念日举行游行。

en: a position in a schedule or list
example: There is a slot for harbour trips every Saturday morning.
exampleZh: 每周六上午都安排了一个港口游览时段。

en: to get something back from a place
example: Volunteers retrieved old letters from the national archive.
exampleZh: 志愿者们从国家档案馆取回了旧信件。

en: the quality of holding back or controlling yourself
example: The curators showed great restraint and kept the original planks.
exampleZh: 修复者表现得非常克制，保留了原来的船板。

en: a change made to improve a plan or text
example: A mid-season revision of the rules solved the rota problem.
exampleZh: 赛季中期对规则的一次修改解决了排班问题。

en: to throw something away because it is not wanted
example: We discarded the old chemical sprays found in the shed.
exampleZh: 我们丢弃了棚子里找到的旧化学喷剂。

en: the act of eating, drinking or using something
example: The garden plans its beds around local consumption, not display.
exampleZh: 这个菜园按照本地食用需求而非观赏效果来规划苗床。

en: to end a law, rule or system officially
example: The committee voted to abolish the membership fee entirely.
exampleZh: 委员会投票决定彻底取消会员费。

en: an animal that hunts and eats other animals
example: Ladybirds are a natural predator of aphids.
exampleZh: 瓢虫是蚜虫的天然捕食者。

en: the first public appearance of something
example: The new stall made its debut at the Saturday market.
exampleZh: 这个新摊位在周六集市上首次亮相。

en: something that is offered to others
example: The garden's main offering is cheap vegetables for families.
exampleZh: 这个菜园主要提供的是给家庭的廉价蔬菜。

en: only; and nothing else
example: The decision was based solely on the test results.
exampleZh: 这个决定完全基于测试结果。

en: to deal with a difficult problem
example: The team met early to tackle the leaking roof.
exampleZh: 团队早早碰头，处理漏雨的屋顶。

en: the way someone thinks about something
example: Her outlook on city life changed after the trip.
exampleZh: 那次旅行之后，她对城市生活的看法变了。

en: an action, especially a good one
example: Helping the lost child was a kind deed.
exampleZh: 帮助那个迷路的孩子是一件善举。

en: to obey a rule or request
example: All staff must comply with the safety rules.
exampleZh: 所有员工都必须遵守安全规定。

en: a small sign worn to show who you are
example: Every visitor receives a badge at the gate.
exampleZh: 每位访客在门口都会领到一枚徽章。

en: the act of taking money out of an account
example: The bank limits each withdrawal to five hundred pounds.
exampleZh: 银行把每笔取款限制在五百英镑以内。

en: a small simple house made of wood
example: We spent the weekend in a wooden cabin by the lake.
exampleZh: 我们在湖边的一座小木屋里度过了周末。

en: to use something or someone unfairly for gain
example: Some companies exploit young workers with long hours.
exampleZh: 有些公司用超长工时剥削年轻员工。

en: to start something new and important
example: She will embark on a new career next month.
exampleZh: 下个月她将开始一份新的职业。

en: to take someone to court
example: The neighbours threatened to sue the factory over the noise.
exampleZh: 邻居们威胁要就噪声问题起诉这家工厂。

en: to take turns or turn around a centre
example: The nurses rotate their shifts every two weeks.
exampleZh: 护士们每两周轮换一次班。

en: to make something happen faster
example: New machines helped accelerate the harvest.
exampleZh: 新机器帮助加快了收割进度。

en: by chance, without planning
example: He accidentally deleted the file this morning.
exampleZh: 他今天早上不小心删掉了那个文件。

en: by which; through which
example: They set up a system whereby students vote for the menu.
exampleZh: 他们建立了一套制度，凭此学生可以投票决定菜单。

en: a newspaper article giving the editor's opinion
example: The editorial called for cleaner air in the city.
exampleZh: 这篇社论呼吁让城市空气更清洁。

en: the money that is spent
example: Public expenditure on schools rose last year.
exampleZh: 去年用于学校的公共开支增加了。

en: someone competing for a prize or position
example: She is a strong contender for the gold medal.
exampleZh: 她是金牌的有力争夺者。

en: not obvious; hard to notice
example: There is a subtle difference between the two colours.
exampleZh: 这两种颜色之间有细微的差别。

en: the joint in the middle of your arm
example: He hurt his elbow during the football match.
exampleZh: 他在足球比赛中伤到了胳膊肘。

en: a group of animals living together
example: A colony of bees settled under the roof.
exampleZh: 一群蜜蜂在屋顶下安了家。

en: to change facts so they are no longer true
example: The article distorted what the scientist had said.
exampleZh: 这篇文章歪曲了那位科学家说过的话。

en: of many different kinds
example: The course offers varied activities for young learners.
exampleZh: 这门课程为年幼的学习者提供各种各样的活动。

en: relating to the basic laws of a country or state
example: The court will decide whether the new tax is constitutional.
exampleZh: 法院将裁定这项新税是否符合宪法。

en: producing good results
example: The meeting was short but very productive.
exampleZh: 这次会议很短，但非常富有成效。

en: the group of people who make laws
example: The state legislature passed the bill by two votes.
exampleZh: 州议会以两票之差通过了该法案。

en: reasonable and acceptable
example: Parents raised legitimate concerns about the school bus.
exampleZh: 家长们对校车提出了合理的担忧。

en: strange or unusual
example: The shop has a peculiar smell of old paper.
exampleZh: 这家店有一股旧纸张的怪味。

en: as can reasonably be argued
example: She is arguably the best player on the team this season.
exampleZh: 她可以说是本赛季队里最好的球员。

en: a university student who has not yet taken a first degree
example: My cousin is an undergraduate studying history at a small university.
exampleZh: 我表妹是一所小型大学里读历史的本科生。

zh: 固定设施；长期存在的事物
en: a thing that is always present in a place or situation
example: The old clock in the hall has been a fixture of the school for decades.
exampleZh: 门厅里的旧钟几十年来一直是学校固定的存在。

en: the ability to say clever and amusing things
example: Her wit made even the dullest meeting enjoyable for everyone.
exampleZh: 她的风趣让哪怕最枯燥的会议也变得愉快。

en: extremely beautiful or impressive
example: The view from the hilltop was stunning on that clear morning.
exampleZh: 那天清晨，从山顶望去的景色令人惊叹。

en: the quality of treating people equally and justly
example: The pupils complained about the fairness of the new grading rules.
exampleZh: 学生们对新评分规则的公平性提出了抱怨。

en: to promise seriously that you will do something
example: The company pledged to plant a tree for every order it received.
exampleZh: 该公司承诺每收到一笔订单就种一棵树。

en: to cut an amount or price by a large degree
example: The shop slashed its prices to clear the winter stock.
exampleZh: 这家店大幅降价以清空冬季库存。

en: attention that someone or something gets from the public
example: The charity gained a lot of publicity after the singer's visit.
exampleZh: 那位歌手来访后，这家慈善机构获得了大量关注。

en: a situation in which two things happen at the same time by chance
example: It was a strange coincidence that we both booked the same flight.
exampleZh: 我们俩订了同一趟航班，真是奇怪的巧合。

en: very valuable and not to be wasted
example: The few hours we spend together each week are precious to me.
exampleZh: 我们每周共处的那几个小时对我来说很珍贵。

en: feeling affection or liking for someone or something
example: She keeps fond memories of the summers she spent by the sea.
exampleZh: 她对在海边度过的那些夏天怀有深情的回忆。

en: better in quality than someone or something else
example: The hotel's breakfast is superior to anything nearby.
exampleZh: 这家酒店的早餐比附近任何一家都好。

en: to interrupt something and stop it working normally
example: A loud argument in the corridor disrupted the whole lesson.
exampleZh: 走廊里的大声争吵打乱了整堂课。

en: to give moral advice in a persistent way
example: My uncle likes to preach about saving money at every dinner.
exampleZh: 我叔叔每次吃饭都喜欢就攒钱说教一番。

en: large in amount or degree
example: The repairs will take a considerable amount of time and money.
exampleZh: 维修将花费相当多的时间和金钱。

en: an urgent request for something
example: The family made a plea for help after the flood.
exampleZh: 洪水过后，这家人发出了求助的恳求。

en: wood used for building or making things
example: The old barn was built from local timber a century ago.
exampleZh: 这座旧谷仓是一个世纪前用当地的木材建造的。

en: the part of a telephone that you hold to your ear
example: She lifted the receiver before the second ring.
exampleZh: 第二声铃响之前她就拿起了听筒。

en: unfavorable and likely to cause problems
example: The match was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
exampleZh: 比赛因不利的天气状况取消了。

en: covering a large area or involving a lot
example: The storm caused extensive damage to the coastal road.
exampleZh: 风暴对沿海公路造成了大量损坏。

en: disagreement, or a point argued in a discussion
example: The new tax became a source of contention in the village.
exampleZh: 新税成了村里争论的源头。

en: a detailed description of how something must be made
example: The builders followed the specification for the roof exactly.
exampleZh: 施工方完全按照屋顶的规格说明施工。

en: a difficult situation that limits your choices
example: Losing both keys left us in a real bind.
exampleZh: 两把钥匙都丢了，让我们陷入了真正的困境。

en: causing strong public disagreement
example: The plan to close the library proved highly controversial.
exampleZh: 关闭图书馆的计划引起了很大争议。

en: the act of carrying out a plan or task
example: The design was good, but its execution was careless.
exampleZh: 设计不错，但执行得很草率。

en: a secret plan by a group to do something harmful
example: The film is about a conspiracy to hide the truth.
exampleZh: 这部电影讲的是一个隐瞒真相的阴谋。

en: a question asking for information
example: The teacher answered every query about the exam calmly.
exampleZh: 老师平静地回答了关于考试的每一个疑问。

en: to take control of a place or people by force
example: The Roman army took four years to conquer the mountain region.
exampleZh: 罗马军队花了四年时间征服这个山区。

en: the unfair use of people or resources for profit
example: The report condemned the exploitation of young workers in the factory.
exampleZh: 报告谴责了这家工厂对年轻工人的剥削。

en: a small group within a larger group that disagrees with the rest
example: A faction within the party opposed the new leader.
exampleZh: 党内一个派系反对这位新领导人。

en: belonging naturally to a place; native
example: The museum works closely with indigenous communities to protect sacred sites.
exampleZh: 博物馆与土著社区密切合作，保护圣地。

en: felt or done by two sides towards each other
example: Their partnership is based on mutual trust and regular talks.
exampleZh: 他们的合作建立在相互信任和定期会谈的基础上。

en: a fault or imperfection in something
example: Engineers found a defect in the braking system of the new train.
exampleZh: 工程师在新列车的制动系统中发现了一处缺陷。

en: real and sincere, not false
example: Her apology sounded genuine, and the team accepted it at once.
exampleZh: 她的道歉听起来很真诚，团队立刻接受了。

en: to force someone to do something, usually by law or duty
example: The new rules oblige drivers to carry a warning triangle.
exampleZh: 新规定要求司机随车携带三角警示牌。

en: a government department headed by a minister
example: The health ministry announced free vaccines for all children.
exampleZh: 卫生部宣布为所有儿童提供免费疫苗。

en: a shop or a media organisation that publishes news
example: The story was first reported by a small online outlet.
exampleZh: 这条新闻最初由一家小型网络媒体报道。

en: a copy of something, or the process of producing young
example: The gallery sells high-quality reproductions of the original painting.
exampleZh: 这家画廊出售原画的高质量复制品。

en: well known for something bad
example: The building is infamous for its blocked fire exits.
exampleZh: 这栋楼因消防出口被堵而臭名昭著。

en: causing death
example: A single mistake on that road can be fatal.
exampleZh: 在那条路上犯一个错误就可能是致命的。

en: to organise people or activities so that they work well together
example: She was hired to coordinate the rescue work across three towns.
exampleZh: 她被聘来协调三个镇的救援工作。

en: a group of people sharing customs and ancestry
example: The tribe has lived along the river for centuries.
exampleZh: 这个部落已经在河边生活了几个世纪。

en: very beautiful, impressive or wonderful
example: We woke to glorious sunshine and a calm blue sea.
exampleZh: 我们醒来时阳光灿烂，海面平静湛蓝。

en: the official who controls a sports game
example: The referee stopped the match when the storm began.
exampleZh: 暴风雨来临时，裁判中止了比赛。

en: how common something is in a place or group
example: Doctors are worried by the prevalence of smoking among teenagers.
exampleZh: 医生对青少年吸烟的普遍程度感到担忧。

en: being forced to live away from your own country
example: The writer spent ten years in exile before returning home.
exampleZh: 这位作家流亡十年后才回到家乡。

en: a set of beliefs taught or officially accepted
example: The old doctrine says the land belongs to the community.
exampleZh: 这一古老教义认为土地属于社群。

en: a person who pays rent to use land or a building
example: Every tenant in the building received a notice about the repairs.
exampleZh: 楼里每位租户都收到了一份关于维修的通知。

en: the right to sell a company's goods or run a service
example: The company won the franchise to run the city's buses.
exampleZh: 这家公司赢得了经营该市公交线路的特许经营权。

en: complete control of a market by one company
example: The regulator broke up the monopoly in the phone market.
exampleZh: 监管机构打破了电话市场的垄断。

en: a formal offer of money or a proposal
example: Three firms submitted a bid for the bridge contract.
exampleZh: 三家公司为这座桥梁的合同提交了投标。

en: the act of making people obey a law or rule
example: Without proper enforcement, the new rules mean little.
exampleZh: 没有恰当的执行，新规定意义不大。

en: dishonest behaviour by people in power
example: The inquiry found corruption at the highest level of the council.
exampleZh: 调查发现市议会最高层存在腐败。

en: an accident in which two vehicles or objects hit each other
example: The collision between the bus and the van injured nine people.
exampleZh: 公交车与面包车相撞，造成九人受伤。

en: the act of saying no to a request
example: His refusal to answer the question angered the committee.
exampleZh: 他拒绝回答这个问题，激怒了委员会。

en: to make something valid again or start it again
example: The library allows readers to renew each book online twice.
exampleZh: 图书馆允许读者在网上为每本书续借两次。

en: relating to an organization or an established system
example: Institutional support helped the small museum survive its first difficult year.
exampleZh: 机构层面的支持帮助这家小博物馆度过了艰难的第一年。

en: a company or person that sends out radio or television programmes
example: The national broadcaster aired the debate live on both channels.
exampleZh: 这家全国性广播公司在两个频道直播了那场辩论。

en: easily damaged or needing careful handling
example: Negotiations over the new contract remain delicate after last week's argument.
exampleZh: 上周的争执之后，新合同的谈判仍然很微妙。

en: exactly the same in every detail
example: The two reports were identical, even though they were written separately.
exampleZh: 尽管是分开写的，两份报告却完全相同。

en: to remove or get rid of something completely
example: The new schedule should eliminate the long waits at the front desk.
exampleZh: 新的排班应该能消除前台长时间的等待。

en: to argue or claim that something is true
example: Several residents contend that the new road will increase noise at night.
exampleZh: 几位居民主张，这条新路会增加夜间的噪音。

en: an informal word for a US dollar or money in general
example: He fixed the old lamp himself and saved twenty bucks.
exampleZh: 他自己修好了旧台灯，省了二十美元。

en: the work needed to keep something in good condition
example: Regular maintenance keeps the building's heating system running through winter.
exampleZh: 定期保养让这栋楼的供暖系统整个冬天都能正常运转。

en: a person or business competing with another
example: The bakery across the street is our closest rival.
exampleZh: 街对面那家面包店是我们最接近的竞争对手。

en: a feeling of kindness towards people who are suffering
example: She treated every patient with patience and genuine compassion.
exampleZh: 她以耐心和真诚的关怀对待每一位病人。

en: to remove or take something out
example: The dentist had to extract the damaged tooth carefully.
exampleZh: 牙医不得不小心地拔掉那颗坏牙。

en: a good quality that deserves praise
example: The committee approved the plan on its own merit.
exampleZh: 委员会是根据该计划本身的价值批准它的。

en: to make an action seem reasonable or necessary
example: The evidence is too thin to warrant a full investigation.
exampleZh: 证据太薄弱，不足以成为进行全面调查的理由。

en: a set of tools or items for a particular purpose
example: The first-aid kit is kept in the cupboard by the door.
exampleZh: 急救箱放在门边的柜子里。

en: information spread to make people support a cause, often unfairly
example: The film was criticised as propaganda rather than honest history.
exampleZh: 这部电影被批评为政治宣传，而非诚实的历史。

en: to grow plants or develop a quality or habit
example: Teachers try to cultivate curiosity rather than simply reward correct answers.
exampleZh: 老师们努力培养好奇心，而不是仅仅奖励正确答案。

en: something that has the same value or meaning as another thing
example: A good meal here costs the equivalent of two cinema tickets.
exampleZh: 这里一顿好饭的价格相当于两张电影票。

en: to leave something in liquid, or to absorb liquid
example: You should soak the beans overnight before cooking them.
exampleZh: 煮豆子之前你应该先把它浸泡一夜。

en: the basic systems and buildings a place needs to work
example: The village lacks the infrastructure to handle so many visitors.
exampleZh: 这个村庄缺乏接待这么多游客的基础设施。

en: advanced and complex, or showing a lot of experience
example: The lab uses sophisticated equipment to measure tiny changes in air pressure.
exampleZh: 实验室使用精密设备测量气压的微小变化。

en: to make something stronger or combine several things
example: The team consolidated its lead with two quick goals.
exampleZh: 球队凭借两个快速进球巩固了领先优势。

en: the fact of not being able to do something
example: His inability to remember names made networking difficult.
exampleZh: 他记不住名字，这让社交变得困难。

en: a person who takes over a job or position from another
example: The board will announce the manager's successor next month.
exampleZh: 董事会将于下个月宣布经理的继任者。

en: to go beyond a limit or be greater than something
example: Sales in December may exceed the target set in June.
exampleZh: 十二月的销售额可能超过六月设定的目标。

en: an official attempt to find out the truth about something
example: The regulator opened a probe into the company's pricing.
exampleZh: 监管机构对该公司的定价展开了调查。

en: the act of getting involved in something that is not your business
example: The coach complained about interference from the club's owners.
exampleZh: 教练抱怨俱乐部老板们的干涉。

en: a very strong feeling of dislike
example: The campaign stirred hatred between the two neighbouring communities.
exampleZh: 这场运动在两个相邻社区之间煽起了仇恨。

en: belonging separately to each person or thing
example: After the meeting, the two managers went back to their respective offices.
exampleZh: 会议结束后，两位经理各自回到自己的办公室。

en: a list of items arranged in a clear order
example: She found the novel in the library's online catalogue.
exampleZh: 她在图书馆的在线目录里找到了这本小说。

zh: 引人入胜的；令人信服的
en: so interesting or convincing that you must pay attention
example: The documentary about the lost village was so compelling that I watched it twice.
exampleZh: 那部关于消失村庄的纪录片太引人入胜了，我看了两遍。

en: simple and not carefully made
example: The shelter was a crude hut built from old boards and plastic sheets.
exampleZh: 那个栖身之处是一间用旧木板和塑料布搭成的简陋小屋。

en: to make someone feel less worried
example: The doctor reassured her that the pain would pass in a few days.
exampleZh: 医生让她放心，疼痛几天后就会消失。

en: a book someone writes about their own life
example: In his memoir, he describes the winter his family spent in a refugee camp.
exampleZh: 在他的回忆录里，他描述了全家在难民营度过的那年冬天。

en: a particular area of activity or knowledge
example: She is well known in the realm of children's publishing.
exampleZh: 她在童书出版领域很有名。

en: strange and unfamiliar
example: The rules of the new school felt alien to him at first.
exampleZh: 起初，新学校的规矩让他觉得很陌生。

en: to beat food such as cream until it becomes thick
example: Whip the cream until it forms soft peaks.
exampleZh: 把奶油搅打到形成柔软的尖峰。

en: the act of taking part in something

en: a reporter who sends news from a place

exampleZh: 这名驻外记者从边境进行了现场报道。

en: the children or young of a person or animal

exampleZh: 这位农民希望他的子女将来接管这片土地。

en: a group that regularly checks an area for safety

exampleZh: 一支夜间巡逻队每小时穿过村庄一次。

en: a planned way of achieving something

exampleZh: 转换话题是那场辩论中一个聪明的策略。

en: an act of buying, selling or exchanging something

exampleZh: 银行把每一笔交易都记录在一个安全文件里。

en: a state of agreement or close cooperation

exampleZh: 这次会议显示出双方利益高度一致。

en: the parts that make up a whole

exampleZh: 选举之后委员会的构成发生了变化。

en: to make a law officially

exampleZh: 议会去年十一月颁布了新规则。

en: the system of owning people as property

exampleZh: 这座博物馆讲述该地区奴隶制的历史。

en: relating to making laws
example: The legislative committee will review the bill next week.
exampleZh: 立法委员会将于下周审议该法案。

en: a formal offer to do work at a stated price

exampleZh: 三家公司为这座桥梁工程提交了投标。

en: to keep something going over time
example: The small shop could not sustain such high rents.
exampleZh: 这家小店无法承受如此高的租金。

en: to consider something to be true or of a certain quality
example: The judges deemed the painting the best in the show.
exampleZh: 评委们认为这幅画是展览中最好的作品。

en: a fixed maximum or minimum number allowed
example: The factory met its monthly quota of parts.
exampleZh: 工厂完成了每月的零件配额。

en: the act of making information public
