exampleZh: 投票前必须完整披露成本。

en: at the same time
example: The two alarms rang simultaneously across the building.
exampleZh: 两个警报器同时响彻整栋大楼。

en: increasing very quickly and suddenly
example: The small app saw explosive growth after a famous chef recommended it.
exampleZh: 一位名厨推荐后，这款小应用迎来了爆炸式增长。

en: money that a business or event receives
example: The concert raised more revenue than the organizers had expected.
exampleZh: 这场音乐会带来的收入超过了组织者的预期。

en: your name written by yourself
example: Please put your signature at the bottom of the form.
exampleZh: 请在表格底部签上你的名字。

en: not covered or decorated
example: The walls looked bare until we hung a few photos.
exampleZh: 在我们挂上几张照片之前，墙壁看上去光秃秃的。

en: a room in a hospital for patients
example: She spent two nights in the children's ward after her operation.
exampleZh: 手术后，她在儿童病房住了两晚。

en: a claim that someone did something wrong
example: The company denied the allegation and asked for an investigation.
exampleZh: 公司否认了这一指控，并要求展开调查。

en: a person chosen to speak for a group
example: Each class sent one delegate to the student council meeting.
exampleZh: 每个班派一名代表参加学生会会议。

en: relating to a city or town government
example: The municipal library is open until nine on weekdays.
exampleZh: 市立图书馆工作日在晚上九点前开放。

en: to shut loudly and with force
example: He was so angry that he slammed the door behind him.
exampleZh: 他气得把门砰地关上了。

en: to officially forbid something
example: The new law prohibits smoking in all public buildings.
exampleZh: 新法律禁止在所有公共建筑内吸烟。

en: an area whose voters elect a representative
example: She has represented this constituency for more than ten years.
exampleZh: 她代表这个选区已有十多年。

en: in a way that is not clear or known
example: Somehow she managed to finish the report before midnight.
exampleZh: 不知怎么的，她设法在午夜前完成了报告。

en: to happen at the same time
example: Our holiday happened to coincide with the town's music festival.
exampleZh: 我们的假期恰好与镇上的音乐节同时。

en: a limit or value that shapes how something works
example: The team set clear parameters for the budget and the schedule.
exampleZh: 团队为预算和进度设定了明确的界限。

en: to tell someone confidently that something is true
example: The doctor assured her that the test results were normal.
exampleZh: 医生向她保证检查结果正常。

en: able to make people believe something
example: His explanation was convincing enough to satisfy the whole committee.
exampleZh: 他的解释很有说服力，足以让整个委员会满意。

en: that is to say; used to name something exactly
example: One student, namely Tom, had read the whole book.
exampleZh: 有一名学生，也就是汤姆，读完了整本书。

en: having many carefully arranged details
example: They built an elaborate model of the bridge for the science fair.
exampleZh: 他们为科学展制作了一座精巧的桥梁模型。

en: to bring something back to its earlier good condition
example: Volunteers worked for months to restore the old railway station.
exampleZh: 志愿者们工作了数月，修复这座老火车站。

en: a small sign or piece of advice
example: There was a hint of rain in the cool morning air.
exampleZh: 凉爽的晨风中有一丝要下雨的迹象。

en: a person who manages the daily work of an organization
example: The hospital administrator explained the new visiting rules.
exampleZh: 医院的管理者解释了新的探视规定。

en: causing serious damage
example: The destructive storm flattened several trees along the road.
exampleZh: 这场破坏性的风暴刮倒了路边的几棵树。

en: to give money or resources for a purpose
example: The school will allocate more funds to the music department.
exampleZh: 学校将向音乐系拨出更多资金。

en: the work of treating or organizing something
example: The processing of the applications took almost three weeks.
exampleZh: 处理这些申请花了将近三周。

en: happy because a worry has gone away
example: She felt relieved when the missing keys turned up.
exampleZh: 丢失的钥匙找到时，她松了一口气。

en: easy to recognize because it is different
example: The building has a distinctive roof shaped like a wave.
exampleZh: 这座建筑有一个形似波浪的独特屋顶。

en: to bring a memory or feeling to mind
example: That song always evokes memories of our first summer together.
exampleZh: 那首歌总能唤起我们共度第一个夏天的回忆。

en: a separate section of a train for passengers
example: We found seats in the last carriage of the train.
exampleZh: 我们在火车最后一节车厢找到了座位。

zh: 令人沮丧的；使人受挫的
en: making you feel annoyed or discouraged because you cannot succeed
example: It was frustrating to watch the same error repeat all morning.
exampleZh: 眼看着同一个错误整个上午反复出现，真让人沮丧。

en: causing great sadness, often because of death or serious loss
example: The fire was a tragic event that changed the whole village.
exampleZh: 那场火灾是一个悲惨的事件，改变了整个村庄。

zh: 实证的；以实验为依据的
en: based on real observation or experiments rather than theory
example: The team offered empirical evidence from three years of lab tests.
exampleZh: 该团队提供了来自三年实验室测试的实证证据。

en: to see or understand the difference between things
example: Young readers often cannot distinguish fact from opinion online.
exampleZh: 年轻读者常常无法在网上区分事实与观点。

en: the teachers and researchers at a university
example: The faculty voted to change how first-year labs are taught.
exampleZh: 全体教员投票决定改变一年级实验课的教学方式。

en: to make something start suddenly
example: One question from a student sparked a long debate.
exampleZh: 一名学生提出的一个问题引发了一场长时间的争论。

en: following the usual and accepted way of doing things
example: Her conventional teaching style left little room for questions.
exampleZh: 她传统的教学风格几乎不给提问留空间。

en: the movement of people from one place to another
example: The migration of young workers to big cities continues.
exampleZh: 年轻工人向大城市的迁移仍在继续。

en: an angry meeting or direct conflict between two sides
example: A calm talk avoided a confrontation between the two neighbours.
exampleZh: 一次平静的交谈避免了两位邻居之间的冲突。

en: respected and admired for quality or success
example: She won a place at a prestigious art school.
exampleZh: 她赢得了一所有声望的艺术学校的入学名额。

en: to put a plan or decision into practice
example: The school will implement the new timetable next month.
exampleZh: 学校将于下个月实施新的时间表。

en: an amount that is more than needed or reasonable
example: An excess of sugar in the diet harms the teeth.
exampleZh: 饮食中过量的糖会损害牙齿。

en: the freedom to decide what should be done in a situation
example: Teachers may use their discretion when marking late work.
exampleZh: 教师在批改迟交作业时可以自行决定。

en: holding very strong political or religious views that most people reject
example: The newspaper described the small group as extremist.
exampleZh: 报纸把那个小团体描述为极端主义的。

en: a condition or rule in a law or agreement
example: A special provision protects small shops from the new tax.
exampleZh: 一项特别条款保护小店免受新税影响。

en: a place where people buy and sell goods
example: Farmers bring fresh vegetables to the marketplace every Saturday.
exampleZh: 农民每周六把新鲜蔬菜带到集市。

en: complete and careful, with attention to every detail
example: The mechanic gave the old car a thorough check.
exampleZh: 修理工对那辆旧车做了彻底的检查。

en: according to what many people say, though it may not be true
example: The cafe is supposedly the oldest one in town.
exampleZh: 这家咖啡馆据说是镇上最古老的一家。

en: a part or share of a whole
example: A large proportion of students walk to school.
exampleZh: 很大一部分学生步行上学。

en: a senior official in charge of a department
example: The commissioner promised to review the new rules.
exampleZh: 专员承诺重新审查这些新规定。

en: a small class or meeting where a subject is discussed
example: She attended a seminar on food safety last week.
exampleZh: 她上周参加了一场关于食品安全的研讨会。

en: to go down from a higher place
example: We began to descend the mountain before the light faded.
exampleZh: 我们在天色变暗前开始下山。

en: money that a person or business earns
example: Her earnings from the small shop doubled last year.
exampleZh: 她小店的收入去年翻了一番。

en: famous and respected for a particular quality
example: The village is renowned for its sweet apples.
exampleZh: 这个村子以甜苹果而闻名。

en: coming from a god, or simply wonderful
example: The old temple was treated as a divine place.
exampleZh: 那座古庙被视为神圣之地。

en: a firm hold with your hand
example: He kept a firm grip on the railing.
exampleZh: 他紧紧抓住栏杆。

en: a temporary alliance of groups with a shared aim
example: A coalition of neighbours saved the old library.
exampleZh: 一个邻里联盟保住了那座老图书馆。

en: a group of soldiers, or a group of people or animals
example: A troop of soldiers marched along the muddy road.
exampleZh: 一队士兵沿着泥泞的道路行进。

en: repeated unwanted words or actions that upset someone
example: She reported the constant teasing as harassment at work.
exampleZh: 她把工作中持续不断的取笑举报为骚扰。

en: clearly different or easy to notice
example: The twins have distinct voices, and I can tell them apart.
exampleZh: 这对双胞胎的嗓音截然不同，我能把他们分辨出来。

en: the act of bringing something back into use or life
example: The old theatre's revival brought young audiences back downtown.
exampleZh: 那家老剧院的复兴把年轻观众重新带回了市中心。

en: relating to the theatre, or exaggerated for effect
example: His theatrical gestures made even a simple greeting look like a performance.
exampleZh: 他夸张的动作让一句简单的问候都像一场表演。

en: to keep something within limits
example: Please confine your comments to the topic we are discussing.
exampleZh: 请把你的评论限制在我们正在讨论的话题上。

en: to manage or organize something such as funds or tests
example: She was asked to administer the club's small budget carefully.
exampleZh: 有人请她小心管理社团那笔微薄的预算。

en: a public statement of support or approval
example: The coach's endorsement helped the young player win a scholarship.
exampleZh: 教练的支持帮助这名年轻球员赢得了奖学金。

en: to officially end a group, or to mix into a liquid
example: The members voted to dissolve the club after twenty years.
exampleZh: 成员们投票决定在二十年后解散这个社团。

en: work sent in for a competition or publication
example: Late submission of the essay will lower your final grade.
exampleZh: 迟交作文会降低你的期末成绩。

en: a group of people chosen to represent others
example: A small delegation of students met the head teacher on Friday.
exampleZh: 一个由学生组成的小型代表团周五见了校长。

en: to see or show the difference between things
example: Young readers often cannot differentiate between fact and opinion.
exampleZh: 年轻读者常常无法区分事实和观点。

en: based on personal choice rather than reason or rules
example: The editor's arbitrary decision upset the whole writing team.
exampleZh: 主编武断的决定让整个写作团队都很不满。

en: connected with literature or good writing
example: The school's literary magazine publishes poems and short stories.
exampleZh: 学校的文学杂志刊登诗歌和短篇小说。

en: the act of taking something or someone away
example: The removal of the old editor surprised everyone in the club.
exampleZh: 老主编被免职让社团里所有人都很惊讶。

en: a person whose job is to keep financial records
example: The club's accountant checks every receipt before the monthly meeting.
exampleZh: 社团的会计在每月例会前核对每一张收据。

en: relating to unofficial fighters, or done secretly without official approval
example: The neighbours' guerrilla gardening turned a bare corner into a flower bed.
exampleZh: 邻居们的“游击式”园艺把一个光秃秃的角落变成了花坛。

en: very excited and pleased
example: We were thrilled when the council approved our little garden.
exampleZh: 市政委员会批准我们的小花园时，我们非常高兴。

en: the act of obeying a rule or request
example: The factory must prove compliance with the new safety rules.
exampleZh: 这家工厂必须证明自己遵守了新的安全规定。

en: a person or company hired to do building work
example: A local contractor offered to build the benches for free.
exampleZh: 当地一位承包商提出免费搭建这些长椅。

en: low in pitch or sound
example: The bass notes from the band shook the windows of the hall.
exampleZh: 乐队奏出的低音震得礼堂的窗户发响。

en: a place where roads or lines meet
example: Slow down at the junction where the two main roads meet.
exampleZh: 在两条主干道相交的路口要减速。

en: the joint between the hand and the arm
example: He hurt his wrist while carrying the heavy stone block.
exampleZh: 他搬那块沉重的石头时伤到了手腕。

en: the state of having the same rights and chances
example: The farmers demanded equality with the landowners in the village.
exampleZh: 农民们要求与村里的地主享有平等权利。

en: to break open suddenly, often with a loud noise
example: The balloon burst with a bang and made everyone laugh.
exampleZh: 气球砰的一声爆开，把大家都逗笑了。

en: to tell the details of an event
example: The guide began to recount the story of the old statue.
exampleZh: 讲解员开始详细讲述那座古老雕像的故事。

en: to put someone in prison or keep them trapped
example: The government tried to imprison her for speaking out.
exampleZh: 政府曾试图因她公开发声而监禁她。

en: to cut a shape into wood or stone
example: The artist used simple tools to carve the stone face.
exampleZh: 这位艺术家用简单的工具雕刻出那张石脸。

en: to steal from a person or place
example: Two men tried to rob the museum of its oldest coin.
exampleZh: 两名男子试图抢走博物馆里最古老的硬币。

en: lasting or taking a long time; longer than necessary
example: The lengthy report took the committee three weeks to read.
exampleZh: 委员会花了三周时间才读完这份冗长的报告。

en: done according to a careful plan or method
example: She kept a systematic record of every repair in the old house.
exampleZh: 她把老房子的每一次修缮都做了系统的记录。

en: an impressive sight or show
example: The opening ceremony was a spectacle of light, music and colour.
exampleZh: 开幕式是一场光、音乐与色彩交织的壮观景象。

en: concerned with helping people who are suffering
example: Aid workers described the camp as a humanitarian disaster.
exampleZh: 援助人员称该营地为一场人道主义灾难。

en: to last or stretch across a period of time
example: The restoration would span four difficult years.
exampleZh: 这次修复持续了艰难的四年。

en: a building where Muslims worship
example: The mosque at the end of our street opens at dawn.
exampleZh: 我们街道尽头的清真寺黎明时分开门。

en: the total amount of money a business takes in a period
example: The bookshop's yearly turnover paid for half the repairs.
exampleZh: 书店每年的营业额支付了一半的修缮费用。

en: to burst out suddenly, as a volcano or a strong feeling
example: Anger erupted at the meeting when the licence was mentioned.
exampleZh: 会上提到许可证时，人们愤怒了。

en: relating to the areas outside a city centre
example: They moved to a quiet suburban street after the baby was born.
exampleZh: 孩子出生后，他们搬到了安静的郊区街道。

en: an unexpected problem that makes a situation harder
example: The missing permit was the first complication in the project.
exampleZh: 许可证缺失是这个项目遇到的第一个复杂情况。

en: extremely surprising
example: The laboratory found astonishing levels of solvent in the river.
exampleZh: 实验室在河水中检测到惊人的溶剂含量。

en: a public procession celebrating something
example: The spring parade down Main Street always draws a large crowd.
exampleZh: 沿着主街的春季游行总能吸引大批人群。

en: expected or likely to become something in the future
example: Several prospective buyers withdrew their offers after the leak.
exampleZh: 泄漏事件后，几位潜在买家撤回了报价。

en: the process of charging someone with a crime
example: The company now faces prosecution for ignoring safety rules.
exampleZh: 该公司因无视安全规定而面临起诉。

en: a large, often angry crowd
example: A mob of parents gathered outside the school office.
exampleZh: 一群愤怒的家长聚集在学校办公室外。

en: used to say what you think is probably true
example: No minutes were kept, so presumably the deal was struck in the corridor.
exampleZh: 没有留下会议记录，所以这个协议想必是在走廊里达成的。

en: a set of drawings that tell a funny story
example: The school comic showed the head teacher as a tired general.
exampleZh: 校刊的连环漫画把校长画成一个疲惫的将军。

en: to change a plan, law or document slightly
example: The council voted to amend the plan and add an opt-out.
exampleZh: 委员会投票修订该计划，并增加了退出选项。

en: a small change made to something
example: One small modification satisfied most of the families.
exampleZh: 一处小小的改动就让大多数家庭满意了。

en: required by a rule or law
example: Community service became compulsory for every student that year.
exampleZh: 那一年，社区服务对每个学生都成了必修内容。

en: an official who represents a country abroad
example: The school invited a diplomat to explain the new policy.
exampleZh: 学校邀请了一位外交官来解释新政策。

en: a confident statement that something is true
example: The report's central assertion is that fees will keep rising.
exampleZh: 这份报告的核心主张是学费将继续上涨。

en: according to what people say or report
example: The figures were reportedly leaked two days before publication.
exampleZh: 据报道，这些数据在发布前两天被泄露。

en: how often something happens
example: The incidence of borrowing among students has doubled.
exampleZh: 学生中借贷的发生率已经翻倍。

example: Student debt in the country could soon reach one trillion dollars.
exampleZh: 该国的学生债务可能很快达到一万亿美元。

en: money paid to someone for a loss or injury
example: Students demanded compensation for fees they had paid but never used.
exampleZh: 学生们要求赔偿他们已支付但从未使用的学费。

en: a government or a system of rule
example: The regime in power has cut funding for universities.
exampleZh: 执政政权削减了大学经费。

en: money paid for teaching, especially at a university
example: Average tuition at public universities has risen faster than wages.
exampleZh: 公立大学的平均学费上涨得比工资还快。

en: to prove that an idea or decision is wrong
example: New evidence may overturn the court's original decision.
exampleZh: 新证据可能推翻法院最初的判决。

en: to discuss something with others before deciding
example: The teachers will confer before announcing the final results.
exampleZh: 老师们将在公布最终结果前进行商议。

en: a person who describes or explains events on television or radio
example: The commentator described the final goal with great excitement.
exampleZh: 解说员非常激动地描述了最后一个进球。

en: a simple drawing made quickly
example: She made a quick sketch of the old bridge.
exampleZh: 她为那座老桥画了一幅快速的素描。

en: next to something or together with someone
example: He worked alongside experienced engineers during the summer.
exampleZh: 那个夏天，他同经验丰富的工程师们一起工作。

en: a deep hole dug in the ground
example: Workers dug a large pit behind the new house.
exampleZh: 工人们在新房子后面挖了一个大坑。

en: to fix something firmly inside a surface
example: They will embed a small sensor in the concrete wall.
exampleZh: 他们将在混凝土墙里嵌入一个小传感器。

en: connected with beauty and the appreciation of art
example: The designer made aesthetic choices that pleased many visitors.
exampleZh: 设计师做出的审美选择让许多参观者感到满意。

en: a unit for measuring liquid, about 4.5 litres in Britain
example: The old truck used a gallon of fuel every ten miles.
exampleZh: 那辆旧卡车每十英里消耗一加仑燃料。

en: great unhappiness or suffering
example: The broken heating caused real misery during the cold winter.
exampleZh: 供暖损坏在寒冷的冬天造成了真正的痛苦。

en: the small amount of something that remains after a process
example: A sticky residue was left on the glass after cleaning.
exampleZh: 清洁之后，玻璃上留下了一层黏黏的残留物。

en: the act of starting to use a new method or idea
example: The adoption of solar panels cut the school's energy bills.
exampleZh: 采用太阳能电池板降低了学校的能源开支。

en: the act of working together to produce something
example: The film was a collaboration between two young directors.
exampleZh: 这部电影是两位年轻导演合作的成果。

en: the work of returning something old to its former condition
example: The restoration of the old theatre took nearly three years.
exampleZh: 那座老剧院的修复花了将近三年时间。

en: a Christian priest who leads a church
example: The pastor opened the church hall for local families.
exampleZh: 牧师把教堂大厅开放给当地家庭使用。

en: money or goods given to help a person or group
example: A large donation paid for the new hospital beds.
exampleZh: 一笔大额捐款支付了新病床的费用。

en: the process of helping someone return to a healthy life
example: Her rehabilitation after the accident lasted six months.
exampleZh: 事故后她的康复持续了六个月。

en: a calculation of what will probably happen in the future
example: The latest projection shows sales rising next year.
exampleZh: 最新预测显示明年销售额将上升。

en: an important discovery or sudden success
example: Scientists announced a breakthrough in the treatment of the disease.
exampleZh: 科学家宣布在该疾病的治疗上取得突破。

en: something that could cause harm or damage
example: Loose wires near the door are a serious hazard.
exampleZh: 门附近松动的电线是严重的隐患。

en: the act of including someone or something in a group
example: The inclusion of younger members changed the club's style.
exampleZh: 年轻成员的加入改变了俱乐部的风格。

en: an idea or plan that someone suggests
example: The mayor put forward a bold proposition about housing.
exampleZh: 市长提出了一个关于住房的大胆主张。

en: willingly or without difficulty
example: She readily agreed to help with the survey.
exampleZh: 她爽快地答应帮忙做这项调查。

en: the state of being easily harmed or hurt
example: The storm exposed the vulnerability of the coastal village.
exampleZh: 这场风暴暴露了那个沿海村庄的脆弱。

en: the state of being awake and aware of things
example: The patient lost consciousness for several minutes.
exampleZh: 病人失去了几分钟的意识。

en: the killing of many defenceless people
example: The museum records the massacre of the village in 1915.
exampleZh: 博物馆记录了1915年那个村庄遭到屠杀的事件。

en: involving a lot of effort or care in a short time
example: He spent a week in intensive care after the crash.
exampleZh: 事故发生后，他在重症监护室待了一周。

en: to say what medicine or treatment someone should have
example: The doctor prescribed rest and plenty of water.
exampleZh: 医生开了休息和多喝水的处方。

en: to continue doing something or move forward
example: After a short break, we proceeded with the meeting.
exampleZh: 短暂休息后，我们继续开会。

en: to be in charge of a meeting or ceremony
example: The mayor will preside over the town meeting tonight.
exampleZh: 市长今晚将主持镇民会议。

en: an extra amount paid for something
example: Customers pay a small premium for next-day delivery.
exampleZh: 顾客需为次日送达支付少量额外费用。

en: a collection of historical records
example: The letters are kept in the city archive.
exampleZh: 这些信件保存在市档案馆。

en: the act of becoming involved to change a situation
example: Quick intervention by the neighbours stopped the fire from spreading.
exampleZh: 邻居们的迅速介入阻止了火势蔓延。

en: something you accept as true without proof
example: He acted on the assumption that the shop was still open.
exampleZh: 他想当然地认为商店还开着，并据此行动。

en: to walk around without a clear direction
example: We wandered through the old streets for an hour.
exampleZh: 我们在老街闲逛了一个小时。

en: an area of knowledge or activity
example: Medical ethics lies outside my domain.
exampleZh: 医学伦理不属于我的领域。

en: a natural feeling that guides you without thinking
example: Her first instinct was to call for help.
exampleZh: 她的第一反应是呼救。

en: hard work and effort given to something you care about
example: The team's dedication made the project a success.
exampleZh: 团队的投入使项目获得成功。

en: the process of finding new people to join
example: Recruitment for the summer camp starts in March.
exampleZh: 夏令营的招募工作三月开始。

en: a single part of a story, or a thin thread
example: One strand of the story follows the missing letters.
exampleZh: 故事的其中一条线索追查那些失踪的信件。

en: a machine that moves water or air
example: The old pump in the yard still works.
exampleZh: 院子里的旧水泵还能用。

en: the murder of an important person
example: The film ends with the assassination of a governor.
exampleZh: 影片以一位州长被暗杀告终。

en: to trip or almost fall while walking
example: I stumbled on the stairs and dropped my bag.
exampleZh: 我在楼梯上绊了一下，包掉了。

en: film or video of a real event
example: The police studied footage from the shop camera.
exampleZh: 警方查看了商店摄像头的录像。

en: to give evidence in court or before officials
example: Two witnesses agreed to testify at the hearing.
exampleZh: 两名证人同意在听证会上作证。

en: to want strongly to achieve something
example: She aspires to become a doctor in her hometown.
exampleZh: 她立志在家乡成为一名医生。

en: a firm belief that something is true
example: He spoke with the conviction of someone who had seen it.
exampleZh: 他说话时带着亲眼见过之人的坚定信念。

en: a substance used to give food more flavour
example: A little spice makes the soup taste warmer.
exampleZh: 加一点香料让汤喝起来更暖。

en: boring and not interesting
example: The first half of the film was rather dull.
exampleZh: 影片的前半部分相当乏味。

en: a punishment, or a free kick at goal in football
example: The referee gave a penalty in the final minute.
exampleZh: 裁判在最后一分钟判了点球。

en: gradually and continuously
example: The rain fell steadily for three hours.
exampleZh: 雨连续下了三个小时。

en: strong and healthy; able to withstand difficulty
example: The old bridge is still robust after a century.
exampleZh: 这座老桥百年之后依然坚固。

en: the act of replacing one person or thing with another
example: The coach made a substitution at half time.
exampleZh: 教练在中场休息时换人。

en: the money raised from an event or sale
example: All proceeds from the concert go to charity.
exampleZh: 音乐会的全部收益捐给慈善机构。

en: happy and satisfied with what you have
example: She was content with a simple life in the village.
exampleZh: 她对村里的简朴生活感到满足。

en: a place where people receive medical care
example: The village clinic opens at eight every morning.
exampleZh: 村诊所每天早上八点开门。

en: to become or make stronger
example: The storm is expected to intensify before midnight.
exampleZh: 预计这场风暴会在午夜前加剧。

en: a long narrow waterway for boats or water
example: We cycled along the canal to the next village.
exampleZh: 我们沿着运河骑车去了下一个村子。

en: a local official who judges minor cases
example: The magistrate fined the driver for parking on the pavement.
exampleZh: 地方法官对在人行道上停车的司机处以罚款。

en: annoyed because you cannot achieve something
example: She felt frustrated after her third attempt failed.
exampleZh: 第三次尝试失败后，她感到很沮丧。

en: an image of something seen in water or a mirror
example: He stopped to look at his reflection in the lake.
exampleZh: 他停下来看自己在湖中的倒影。

en: equipment used for a particular purpose
example: The lab apparatus must be cleaned after every experiment.
exampleZh: 每次实验后都必须清洗实验室仪器。

en: failure to give proper care or attention
example: The playground was closed after years of neglect.
exampleZh: 这个操场在多年无人照管后关闭了。

en: extremely beautiful or impressive
example: From the hill we had a magnificent view of the valley.
exampleZh: 从山上我们看到了山谷的壮丽景色。

en: to get rid of something
example: Please dispose of your rubbish in the bins outside.
exampleZh: 请把垃圾扔进外面的垃圾桶里。

en: extremely large
example: The concert attracted an immense crowd to the square.
exampleZh: 这场音乐会吸引了大量人群来到广场。

en: at all; used after a negative word
example: She had no interest whatsoever in the offer.
exampleZh: 她对这个提议毫无兴趣。

en: to one side; out of the way
example: He stepped aside to let the nurse pass.
exampleZh: 他挪到一边，让护士过去。

en: a metal disc given as a prize or honour
example: She won a gold medal in the 200 metres.
exampleZh: 她在200米比赛中赢得了金牌。

en: a set of sheets of paper for writing notes
example: He wrote the address on a small pad by the phone.
exampleZh: 他把地址写在电话旁的小便签本上。

en: a product that can be bought and sold
example: Coffee is a commodity traded around the world.
exampleZh: 咖啡是全世界交易的一种商品。

en: to announce something publicly
example: The mayor proclaimed the new library open.
exampleZh: 市长宣布新图书馆落成开放。

en: a written request signed by many people
example: More than a thousand residents signed the petition.
exampleZh: 一千多名居民在这份请愿书上签了名。

en: to make a problem or difficulty worse
example: Rain compounded the difficulty of the rescue.
exampleZh: 降雨使救援的难度进一步加大。

en: the authority given to a government by voters
example: The party claimed a mandate for change.
exampleZh: 该党声称自己获得了推动变革的授权。

en: to break something into pieces
example: The ball smashed a window on the second floor.
exampleZh: 球把二楼的窗户砸碎了。

en: to join people or parts into one whole
example: The new leader promised to unify the divided country.
exampleZh: 新领导人承诺要统一这个分裂的国家。

en: a brother or sister
example: She has three siblings and they meet every summer.
exampleZh: 她有三个兄弟姐妹，他们每年夏天都会相聚。

en: excellent; of very high quality
example: The chef cooked a superb meal for the guests.
exampleZh: 这位厨师为客人们做了一顿极好的饭。

en: very badly or to a serious degree
example: The old bridge was severely damaged by the flood.
exampleZh: 这座旧桥被洪水严重损坏。

en: a set of political or social beliefs
example: The party's ideology shaped every policy it made.
exampleZh: 该党的意识形态影响了它制定的每一项政策。

en: the act of putting a dead body in the ground
example: The burial took place on a quiet hillside.
exampleZh: 葬礼在一处安静的山坡上举行。

en: the empty space at the side of a page
example: He wrote a few notes in the margin of the page.
exampleZh: 他在那页的页边空白处写了几条笔记。

en: the office or period of being president
example: She won the presidency after a long campaign.
exampleZh: 经过一场漫长的竞选，她赢得了总统职位。

en: relating to the sea or ocean
example: The marine biologist spent three months studying coral reefs in warm water.
exampleZh: 这位海洋生物学家花了三个月研究温暖水域中的珊瑚礁。

en: very noticeable or easy to see
example: There was a pronounced difference between the two brothers' tastes in music.
exampleZh: 这两兄弟在音乐品味上有明显的差异。

en: a set of moral rules guiding behaviour
example: A strong work ethic helped her finish the project ahead of schedule.
exampleZh: 强烈的职业道德感帮助她提前完成了项目。

en: the act of getting rid of something
example: The safe disposal of chemical waste costs the factory a lot of money.
exampleZh: 化学废弃物的安全处理让工厂花费了不少钱。

en: to stop something from spreading or growing
example: The city planted trees along the river to stem soil erosion.
exampleZh: 这座城市沿河种树以遏制水土流失。

en: the act of officially leaving a job
example: After months of stress, he handed in his resignation to the manager.
exampleZh: 在数月的压力之后，他向经理递交了辞呈。

en: to control or decide something
example: Weather conditions often dictate when the fishermen can go out to sea.
exampleZh: 天气状况常常决定渔民何时能出海。

en: a large entrance hall in a building
example: Guests waited in the hotel lobby for the airport bus to arrive.
exampleZh: 客人们在旅馆大厅等候去机场的班车。

en: to move your head down and up to agree
example: The students began to nod when the teacher explained the rule again.
exampleZh: 老师再次解释规则时，学生们开始点头。

en: to face a difficult situation directly
example: The new manager had to confront several serious problems in her first week.
exampleZh: 新经理在头一周不得不面对几个严重问题。

en: a narrow line where something is broken
example: A thin crack ran across the ceiling after the heavy storm.
exampleZh: 那场大暴雨后，天花板上出现了一道细长的裂缝。

en: a person who lives in a place
example: Every inhabitant of the small island knows the ferry timetable by heart.
exampleZh: 这座小岛上的每位居民都熟记渡轮时刻表。

en: an official document granting rights or rules
example: The old charter still sets out how the town council should be elected.
exampleZh: 这份旧章程仍然规定着镇议会应如何选举。

en: a person found guilty of a crime
example: The convict spent five years in prison for stealing a neighbour's car.
exampleZh: 这名罪犯因偷了邻居的车在监狱服刑五年。

en: a legal case brought to a court
example: The family filed a lawsuit against the builder over the damaged walls.
exampleZh: 这家人就墙体损坏一事对建筑商提起了诉讼。

en: a loan used to buy a house
example: They took out a thirty-year mortgage to buy their first flat.
exampleZh: 他们办理了三十年期的抵押贷款来买第一套公寓。

en: to hold on tightly to something
example: The child would cling to her mother's hand in crowded places.
exampleZh: 在人多的地方，那孩子总是紧紧抓住母亲的手。

en: a small metal pin with a spiral thread
example: One loose screw made the whole kitchen door hang at an angle.
exampleZh: 一颗松动的螺丝让整扇厨房门歪斜地挂着。

en: next to or near a place
example: The neighbouring flat shares our wall, so we hear every piano lesson.
exampleZh: 隔壁公寓和我们共用一堵墙，所以每堂钢琴课我们都听得见。

en: the conditions written in an agreement
example: She read the terms of the contract carefully before signing her name.
exampleZh: 她在签名之前仔细阅读了合同的条款。

en: a sudden large increase
example: A sudden surge in demand left the shops without enough bread.
exampleZh: 需求的突然激增让商店的面包供应不足。

en: a lawyer who charges someone in court
example: The prosecutor asked the court to consider the new evidence carefully.
exampleZh: 检察官请法庭仔细考虑新证据。

en: an item shown in a list or advertisement
example: One online listing described the tiny flat as bright and spacious.
exampleZh: 一条网络房源把小小的公寓描述得明亮又宽敞。

en: to confirm or support a decision
example: The court decided to uphold the ban on advertising near schools.
exampleZh: 法院决定维持禁止在学校附近做广告的规定。

en: action taken to stop something bad happening
example: Fire prevention costs less than repairing the damage after a blaze.
exampleZh: 火灾预防的花费比火灾后修复损失要少。

en: to include a range of things
example: The new rules encompass noise, heating and the size of each room.
exampleZh: 新规定涵盖噪音、供暖以及每个房间的面积。

en: very strong or intense
example: Competition for places at the school is fierce every single year.
exampleZh: 这所学校的入学竞争每年都十分激烈。

en: the quality of being believed or trusted
example: Repeating false claims damaged the agency's credibility with local buyers.
exampleZh: 反复发布虚假说法损害了该机构在当地买家中的可信度。

en: force that keeps something moving or growing
example: The team gained momentum after scoring twice in a row.
exampleZh: 连续两次得分后，球队势头渐起。

en: shared by many things; not specific or special
example: The shop sells generic phone cases with no brand name.
exampleZh: 这家店卖的是没有品牌的通用手机壳。

en: a person or thing that takes the place of another
example: Our teacher was ill, so a substitute took the class.
exampleZh: 我们老师病了，于是一位代课老师来上课。

en: the connection between something and the matter at hand
example: The judge questioned the relevance of the old letter to the case.
exampleZh: 法官质疑那封旧信与本案的相关性。

en: completely and with great care
example: She checked the whole report thoroughly before sending it.
exampleZh: 她在发送前把整份报告彻底检查了一遍。

en: an open refusal to obey a person or a system
example: The new rules caused a quiet rebellion among the students.
exampleZh: 新规定在学生中引发了一场无声的反抗。

en: someone who watches an event without taking part
example: Every spectator stood up and cheered when the runner finished.
exampleZh: 当那位跑者冲过终点时，每位观众都站起来欢呼。

en: the back edge of a book, or the backbone
example: The title was printed along the spine of the old book.
exampleZh: 书名印在那本旧书的书脊上。

en: the respect or rank that a person or group has
example: The clinic has a high standing among local families.
exampleZh: 这家诊所在当地家庭中享有很高声望。

en: worth the time, money or effort spent
example: Volunteering at the shelter was hard but worthwhile.
exampleZh: 在收容所做志愿者很辛苦，但很值得。

en: laws made by a government
example: New legislation now requires shops to charge for plastic bags.
exampleZh: 新法规现在要求商店对塑料袋收费。

en: completely, with no doubt
example: I was utterly exhausted after the long train journey.
exampleZh: 长途火车旅行之后我筋疲力尽。

en: a person who receives something
example: The recipient of the award gave a short speech.
exampleZh: 获奖者作了简短的发言。

en: willing to act dishonestly for money or power
example: The corrupt manager was arrested for taking bribes.
exampleZh: 那个腐败的经理因受贿被捕。

en: to go well with something and make it better
example: The sharp sauce complements the mild fish perfectly.
exampleZh: 浓味的酱汁与清淡的鱼搭配得恰到好处。

en: to collect information and arrange it in a list or book
example: She compiled a list of useful websites for new students.
exampleZh: 她为新生汇编了一份实用网站清单。

en: the flat cutting part of a knife or tool
example: The blade of the knife was too dull to cut the bread.
exampleZh: 刀刃太钝，切不动面包。

en: the act of removing someone from a job
example: His sudden dismissal shocked everyone in the office.
exampleZh: 他突然被解雇，办公室所有人都很震惊。

en: the usual way things are done in a group
example: Working from home has become the norm in our company.
exampleZh: 在我们公司，在家办公已成为常态。

en: someone who belongs to a group and knows its secrets
example: An insider told the reporter about the company's plan.
exampleZh: 一名内部人士向记者透露了公司的计划。

en: relating to light or to the sense of sight
example: The optical shop on the corner repairs glasses in a day.
exampleZh: 街角那家眼镜店一天就能修好眼镜。

en: a small amount or example used for study
example: The biologist kept each specimen in a labelled glass jar.
exampleZh: 生物学家把每个标本都放在贴好标签的玻璃罐里。

en: the act of giving out money or resources for a purpose
example: The club argued about the allocation of its small budget.
exampleZh: 俱乐部为小额预算的分配争论不休。

en: to consist of or be made up of
example: The course comprises twelve lessons and two exams.
exampleZh: 这门课程由十二节课和两次考试组成。

en: the head of a school
example: The principal welcomed every new student at the gate.
exampleZh: 校长在校门口迎接每一位新生。

en: to let liquid fall out of its container
example: Be careful not to spill the soup on the carpet.
exampleZh: 小心别把汤洒在地毯上。

en: the middle of a group or situation
example: In the midst of the crowd, I heard my name.
exampleZh: 在人群当中，我听到有人叫我的名字。

en: the quality of staying the same and being reliable
example: Her consistency in training made her the best runner.
exampleZh: 她训练的一贯性使她成为最好的跑者。

en: a place or meeting for public discussion
example: The town forum meets monthly to discuss local transport problems.
exampleZh: 镇上的论坛每月举行一次，讨论当地的交通问题。

en: a signal that tells you what to do or say
example: Her nod was a cue for the band to start playing.
exampleZh: 她的点头是乐队开始演奏的提示。

en: a meeting to get advice or discuss a decision
example: After a long consultation, the doctor recommended more rest and fewer night shifts.
exampleZh: 经过长时间的咨询，医生建议多休息、少上夜班。

en: a written record of events or progress
example: The pilot keeps a log of every flight and every delay.
exampleZh: 这位飞行员记录每一次飞行和每一次延误。

en: unfair treatment of people
example: The workers protested against the injustice of unequal pay for equal work.
exampleZh: 工人们抗议同工不同酬的不公。

en: temporary, used until something permanent is ready
example: An interim manager will run the office until a permanent one is appointed.
exampleZh: 在任命正式人选之前，办公室将由一位临时经理管理。

en: to break into pieces or destroy completely
example: The unexpected news could shatter her confidence in the whole team.
exampleZh: 这个意外的消息可能会击碎她对整个团队的信心。

en: a small broken piece or part of something
example: A fragment of the old letter was found under the desk.
exampleZh: 那封旧信的一片残页在书桌下被找到了。

en: a standard used to compare or judge other things
example: The test results became a benchmark for other schools in the region.
exampleZh: 这些考试结果成为该地区其他学校参照的基准。

en: showing that you understand another person's feelings
example: She was sympathetic when I explained why I had missed the meeting.
exampleZh: 我解释了自己为什么没参加会议时，她表示体谅。

en: very important in making something happen
example: He was instrumental in setting up the village library twenty years ago.
exampleZh: 二十年前，他在创办乡村图书馆一事上起了重要作用。

en: a general rise in prices over time
example: Rising inflation made everyday shopping more expensive for ordinary families.
exampleZh: 不断上升的通货膨胀让普通家庭的日常购物更贵了。

en: special skill or knowledge in a particular field
example: The team needed her expertise to repair the damaged maps.
exampleZh: 团队需要她的专业知识来修复受损的地图。

en: words or actions that show respect and admiration
example: The coach paid tribute to the players after the final match.
exampleZh: 决赛结束后，教练向球员们致敬。

en: polite behaviour that shows respect for others
example: He greeted every guest with great courtesy and remembered all their names.
exampleZh: 他彬彬有礼地迎接每位客人，还记得他们所有人的名字。

en: a person who organises different parts of an activity
example: The volunteer coordinator arranged transport for all the visiting students.
exampleZh: 志愿者协调人为所有来访的学生安排了交通。

en: the inner sense of what is right and wrong
example: His conscience would not let him keep the money he had found.
exampleZh: 他的良心不允许他留下捡到的钱。

en: a long gun that is held against the shoulder
example: The museum displayed a nineteenth-century rifle in a glass case.
exampleZh: 博物馆在一个玻璃柜里展出了一支十九世纪的步枪。

en: to separate someone or something from others
example: Doctors had to isolate the patient to protect the other patients.
exampleZh: 医生不得不隔离这名病人，以保护其他病人。

en: the state of having many connected parts or details
example: The complexity of the rules confused most of the new members.
exampleZh: 规则的复杂性让大多数新成员感到困惑。

en: to state something exactly and clearly
example: Please specify the date and time you would prefer.
exampleZh: 请明确说出你希望的日期和时间。

en: the act of getting or buying something
example: The library announced the acquisition of a rare map collection.
exampleZh: 图书馆宣布收藏了一批珍贵的地图。

en: likely to happen very soon
example: Dark clouds and a cold wind suggested that a storm was imminent.
exampleZh: 乌云和冷风表明一场暴风雨即将来临。

en: a large round container for liquids
example: They stored rainwater in a barrel beside the garden shed.
exampleZh: 他们把雨水储存在花园棚屋旁的一个桶里。

en: to succeed in reaching a goal or level
example: Few runners attain such speed without years of careful training.
exampleZh: 没有多年细心训练，很少有跑者能达到这样的速度。

en: to officially choose something for a purpose
example: The council designated the empty field as a nature reserve.
exampleZh: 市政部门把那片空地划定为自然保护区。

en: the act of watching over work or people
example: Children may use the pool only under adult supervision.
exampleZh: 儿童只有在成人看护下才能使用游泳池。

en: the strength or force of something
example: The intensity of the midday sun surprised the visiting students.
exampleZh: 正午阳光的强度让来访的学生们感到惊讶。

en: a person who manages money or property for others
example: The trustee must approve every payment from the fund.
exampleZh: 受托人必须批准该基金的每一笔付款。

en: a feeling that something is probably wrong or untrue
example: Her suspicion grew when the same excuse was repeated twice.
exampleZh: 同一个借口被重复了两次，她的怀疑加深了。

en: a person who writes music
example: The composer wrote the whole score in only three weeks.
exampleZh: 这位作曲家仅用三周就写完了整份配乐。

en: a large public meeting to support a cause
example: Thousands joined the rally to demand cleaner air.
exampleZh: 数千人参加了要求更清洁空气的集会。

en: although; even though
example: The proposal passed, albeit by a very narrow margin.
exampleZh: 这项提案通过了，尽管优势非常微弱。

en: a public vote on a single political question
example: The city held a referendum on whether to rebuild the bridge.
exampleZh: 该市就是否重建这座桥举行了公投。

en: relating to a president or a president's office
example: The presidential debate drew millions of viewers across the country.
exampleZh: 这场总统辩论吸引了全国数百万观众。

en: to become or make smaller
example: Public interest in the case began to diminish after a month.
exampleZh: 一个月后，公众对这起案件的兴趣开始减弱。

en: to go somewhere risky or try something bold
example: Few sailors venture into those waters during winter.
exampleZh: 冬天很少有水手冒险进入那片海域。

en: a line of light shining from a source
example: A narrow beam of light came through the crack in the door.
exampleZh: 一道窄窄的光束从门缝里照进来。

en: the full right of a place to govern itself
example: The treaty formally recognised the island's sovereignty.
exampleZh: 该条约正式承认了这座岛屿的主权。

en: a stronger liking for one thing over another
example: Most students expressed a clear preference for morning classes.
exampleZh: 大多数学生表示明显更偏好上午的课。

en: spoken or written remarks that explain or judge events
example: His commentary on the match was calm and very detailed.
exampleZh: 他对这场比赛的解说不慌不忙，而且非常详细。

en: a disease that spreads quickly among many people
example: The village closed its school during the flu epidemic.
exampleZh: 流感流行期间，村里关闭了学校。

en: support and unity among people with a shared aim
example: The workers showed solidarity by refusing to cross the picket line.
exampleZh: 工人们拒绝越过纠察线，以此表示团结。

en: a small official change to a law or rule
example: Parliament approved an amendment to the housing act.
exampleZh: 议会批准了对住房法的一项修正案。

en: to become worse over time
example: Without repairs, the old bridge will continue to deteriorate.
exampleZh: 如果不加修缮，这座老桥会继续恶化。

en: a lawyer who advises clients and prepares legal documents
example: She hired a solicitor to review the rental contract.
exampleZh: 她聘请了一位律师来审阅租房合同。

en: in the middle of; surrounded by
example: Amid the confusion, nobody noticed the back door open.
exampleZh: 在混乱之中，没有人注意到后门开着。

en: a person who gives money, help or writing to something
example: Every contributor to the project received a short thank-you note.
exampleZh: 该项目的每一位贡献者都收到了一封简短的感谢信。

en: not willing to do something
example: He was reluctant to leave the party so early.
exampleZh: 他不情愿这么早离开聚会。

en: to state something as true without proof
example: The report alleges that the company hid the results.
exampleZh: 该报道指称公司隐瞒了结果。

en: to admit that something is true
example: The minister finally conceded that the figures were wrong.
exampleZh: 部长最终承认这些数字是错的。

en: to express an idea clearly in words
example: She can articulate difficult ideas in simple language.
exampleZh: 她能用简单的语言清晰表达复杂的观点。

en: a possible result or hidden meaning of something
example: She did not miss the implication of his silence.
exampleZh: 她没有忽略他沉默的含义。

en: a serious disagreement or fight
example: A brief clash over pay delayed the meeting by an hour.
exampleZh: 一场关于薪酬的短暂争执使会议推迟了一小时。

en: a complete path for electricity
example: A faulty circuit caused the lights to fail.
exampleZh: 一处电路故障导致灯全灭了。

en: far away from other places or people
example: The clinic serves several isolated farms in the valley.
exampleZh: 这家诊所服务于山谷里几个偏僻的农场。

en: destroy something completely
example: The storm devastated the coastal village, destroying dozens of homes.
exampleZh: 风暴摧毁了这座海边村庄，毁掉了几十座房屋。

en: a strong hope or goal
example: Her aspiration is to become a doctor in her hometown.
exampleZh: 她的志向是在家乡当一名医生。

en: the release of gas or other substances into the air
example: The new rules aim to cut carbon emission from factories.
exampleZh: 新规定旨在减少工厂的碳排放。

en: a suitable place or role for someone or something
example: The small café found a niche among local office workers.
exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆在当地上班族中找到了自己的市场。

en: turn round and round quickly
example: The wheels began to spin faster as the car sped up.
exampleZh: 汽车加速时车轮开始转得更快。

en: feeling that something is wrong or dishonest
example: The guard became suspicious when the man avoided his eyes.
exampleZh: 那名男子避开他的目光时，警卫起了疑心。

en: suppose something is true without proof
example: I presume you have read the email I sent yesterday.
exampleZh: 我猜想你已经读过我昨天发的邮件了。

en: argue against something
example: She countered my argument with clear evidence from the report.
exampleZh: 她用报告中清晰的证据反驳了我的论点。

en: someone with long experience in something
example: He is a veteran of many tough political campaigns.
exampleZh: 他是许多艰难政治竞选的老手。

en: fill someone's mind so they cannot think of much else
example: The mistake obsessed him for weeks after the exam.
exampleZh: 考试后的几周里，那个错误一直让他耿耿于怀。

en: control or change something dishonestly
example: The company manipulated the data to hide its losses.
exampleZh: 公司操纵数据来掩盖亏损。

en: make a mark on a surface with something sharp
example: The cat scratched the paint on the door.
exampleZh: 猫把门上的漆刮花了。

en: start or come from a particular place
example: The custom originated in a small village by the river.
exampleZh: 这一习俗起源于河边的一个小村庄。

en: a printed sheet with information
example: They handed out a leaflet about the new library hours.
exampleZh: 他们分发了一份关于图书馆新开放时间的传单。

en: a set of rooms, especially in a hotel
example: They booked a suite with a view of the sea.
exampleZh: 他们订了一间海景套房。

en: a member of a senate
example: The senator spoke to a crowd of students.
exampleZh: 这位参议员对一群学生发表了讲话。

en: the range of things something covers
example: The scope of the study was limited to two cities.
exampleZh: 这项研究的范围仅限于两座城市。

en: in a basic or important way
example: The new rules fundamentally changed how we work.
exampleZh: 新规定从根本上改变了我们的工作方式。

en: a sudden, illegal seizure of power
example: The coup forced the president to leave the country.
exampleZh: 这场政变迫使总统离开了这个国家。

en: the right to govern or decide for oneself
example: The region was given greater autonomy after the agreement.
exampleZh: 协议签订后，该地区获得了更大的自治权。

en: a building where journeys begin or end
example: We waited for her at the airport terminal.
exampleZh: 我们在机场航站楼等她。

en: a part or share of something
example: She gave each child a small portion of cake.
exampleZh: 她给每个孩子分了一小块蛋糕。

en: stop something from being expressed or shown
example: He suppressed his anger and answered calmly.
exampleZh: 他压住怒火，平静地回答。

en: a period when business activity falls
example: Many small shops closed during the recession.
exampleZh: 经济衰退期间许多小店关门了。

en: receive something from someone after they die or leave
example: She inherited the farm from her grandmother.
exampleZh: 她从祖母那里继承了这座农场。

en: in or to a lower position than something
example: The cellar beneath the shop keeps the flour cool.
exampleZh: 店铺下面的地窖使面粉保持凉爽。

en: crush something into small pieces or powder
example: She grinds fresh coffee beans every morning.
exampleZh: 她每天早上现磨咖啡豆。

en: a person or thing with the same role elsewhere
example: The minister met her counterpart from Japan.
exampleZh: 这位部长会见了她的日本同行。

en: a small sign that something or someone was there
example: The search dog found a trace of the missing boy near the river.
exampleZh: 搜救犬在河边发现了失踪男孩的踪迹。

en: something valuable passed down from the past
example: The old library is a legacy of the town's wealthiest family.
exampleZh: 这座老图书馆是镇上最富有的家族留下的遗产。

en: to give official approval to something
example: The council agreed to sanction the plan for a new park.
exampleZh: 议会同意批准新建公园的计划。

en: the act of making a device or system start working
example: The activation of the alarm takes only a second.
exampleZh: 警报的启动只需一秒钟。

en: to think about something carefully for a while
example: She sat by the window and contemplated her next move.
exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，仔细考虑下一步该怎么做。

en: completely, with nothing left out
example: I am not wholly convinced by his explanation.
exampleZh: 我并不完全相信他的解释。

en: coming after something else in time
example: The subsequent chapters explain how the project was funded.
exampleZh: 随后的几章解释了该项目是如何获得资金的。

en: to deal with a difficult problem
example: The city must tackle the shortage of affordable homes.
exampleZh: 这座城市必须应对经济适用房短缺的问题。

en: so unreasonable that it seems silly
example: It seemed absurd to build a pool in the desert.
exampleZh: 在沙漠里建游泳池显得很荒唐。

en: happening sometimes but not often
example: We hear occasional noise from the flat upstairs.
exampleZh: 我们偶尔听到楼上公寓传来的噪音。

en: the official power to make legal decisions
example: The harbour falls under the county's jurisdiction, not ours.
exampleZh: 港口属于县里的管辖范围，而不是我们的。

en: a group of senior ministers who advise a leader
example: The prime minister called a cabinet meeting on Monday.
exampleZh: 首相周一召开了内阁会议。

en: a small group of similar things close together
example: A cluster of small shops lines the narrow street.
exampleZh: 一簇小店铺沿着窄街排列。

en: the process of appearing or becoming known
example: The emergence of online shops changed how we buy clothes.
exampleZh: 网店的出现改变了我们买衣服的方式。

en: lasting only a short time
example: She had a passing interest in chess, then gave it up.
exampleZh: 她对国际象棋只有一时的兴趣，后来就放弃了。

en: the state of being kept in prison
example: His imprisonment lasted twelve years for a crime he denied.
exampleZh: 他因一项自己否认的罪行被关押了十二年。

en: relating to elections and voting
example: The party promised tax cuts during the electoral campaign.
exampleZh: 该党在竞选期间承诺减税。

en: to state something firmly as true
example: The report asserts that the bridge is unsafe.
exampleZh: 报告断言这座桥不安全。

en: public attention or a strong beam of light
example: The scandal put the mayor in the spotlight for weeks.
exampleZh: 这桩丑闻让市长数周处于公众关注之中。

en: someone who is very interested in an activity
example: My uncle is a cycling enthusiast who rides every morning.
exampleZh: 我叔叔是个自行车爱好者，每天早上都骑车。

en: used to compare two things or sides
example: Tonight's match is the champions versus the young challengers.
exampleZh: 今晚的比赛是冠军队对年轻的挑战者。

en: someone whose job is to check that rules are followed
example: A safety inspector visited the factory twice last month.
exampleZh: 一名安全检查员上个月两次走访了这家工厂。

en: to allow yourself to enjoy something you like
example: On holiday we indulged in long lunches by the sea.
exampleZh: 度假时我们尽情享受海边的漫长午餐。

en: something you agree to give up in order to end a disagreement
example: Both sides made concessions to reach an agreement.
exampleZh: 双方都作出了让步，以达成协议。

en: to run away from a place or danger
example: The family had to flee their home when the river rose.
exampleZh: 河水上涨时，这家人不得不逃离家园。

en: a person who regularly buys from a shop or business
example: The café gives every patron a free biscuit with coffee.
exampleZh: 这家咖啡馆给每位顾客免费提供一块配咖啡的饼干。

en: an impressive achievement that needs skill or courage
example: Climbing the north face in winter is a remarkable feat.
exampleZh: 冬季攀登北壁是一项了不起的壮举。

en: a model or experience that copies a real situation
example: Pilots train in a flight simulation before flying alone.
exampleZh: 飞行员在独自飞行前要在飞行模拟中训练。

en: a long period with no rain
example: The drought lasted for months and left every field dry.
exampleZh: 这场干旱持续了数月，使每块田地都干枯了。

zh: 不可或缺的；构成整体的
en: necessary and central to something
example: Practice is an integral part of learning a new language.
exampleZh: 练习是学习一门新语言不可或缺的一部分。

en: the ability to do something well
example: Her competence at handling difficult customers impressed the manager.
exampleZh: 她处理难缠顾客的能力给经理留下了深刻印象。

en: cows and bulls kept on a farm
example: The farmer moved his cattle to a field near the river.
exampleZh: 农夫把他的牛赶到了河边的一块地里。

en: someone who works to bring about social change
example: The activist organized a protest against the new road.
exampleZh: 这位活动人士组织了一场反对新公路的抗议。

en: an idea that a plan or argument is based on
example: His argument rests on the premise that prices will keep rising.
exampleZh: 他的论点建立在物价会持续上涨这一前提之上。

en: relating to the management of an organization
example: She handles the administrative work for the whole department.
exampleZh: 她负责整个部门的行政工作。

zh: 处境艰难的；忧心忡忡的
en: having many problems or worries
example: The manager looked troubled when he heard about the missing money.
exampleZh: 经理听说钱不见了，显得忧心忡忡。

en: the highest point or busiest time
example: Hotel prices rise sharply during the peak season.
exampleZh: 旺季时酒店价格大幅上涨。

en: the business of selling goods to the public
example: She has worked in retail for more than ten years.
exampleZh: 她在零售行业工作了十多年。

en: the feeling of being upset because you cannot succeed
example: He slammed the door in frustration after the third failed attempt.
exampleZh: 第三次尝试失败后，他沮丧地摔上了门。

en: for this reason
example: The road was closed, hence the long delay.
exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此耽搁了很久。

en: to lose blood
example: His knee began to bleed after he fell off the bike.
exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来后，膝盖开始流血。

en: to officially join a course or school
example: More than fifty students enrol in the evening course each year.
exampleZh: 每年有五十多名学生报名参加这个晚间课程。

en: a country governed by elected representatives
example: The small republic became independent after a long struggle.
exampleZh: 这个小共和国经过长期斗争后获得了独立。

en: to find and hire new people
example: The company plans to recruit twenty engineers this year.
exampleZh: 公司计划今年招聘二十名工程师。

zh: 有吸引力的；令人感兴趣的
en: attractive or interesting to people
example: The idea of working abroad sounds appealing to many graduates.
exampleZh: 对许多毕业生来说，去国外工作的想法听起来很有吸引力。

en: a connection between two sets of facts
example: The study found a strong correlation between sleep and memory.
exampleZh: 该研究发现睡眠与记忆力之间存在很强的相关性。

en: to come to an end and stop being valid
example: My passport will expire at the end of next month.
exampleZh: 我的护照将在下个月底到期。

en: to use power or influence to make something happen
example: The union can exert considerable pressure on the government.
exampleZh: 工会能对政府施加相当大的压力。

en: to give someone a task or a share of work
example: The teacher will assign each group a different topic.
exampleZh: 老师会给每个小组分配一个不同的主题。

en: the activity of fighting a war
example: New technology has changed the nature of modern warfare.
exampleZh: 新技术改变了现代战争的性质。

en: the movement of people or goods from place to place
example: The goods were damaged in transit between the two cities.
exampleZh: 货物在两地之间运输途中受损。

en: the time when the sun rises
example: The soldiers left the camp at dawn.
exampleZh: 士兵们在黎明时离开了营地。

en: a violent attack
example: The assault on the base lasted less than an hour.
exampleZh: 对基地的袭击持续了不到一小时。

en: a survey of people's opinions
example: A recent poll shows that most voters support the plan.
exampleZh: 最近的一项民意调查显示，大多数选民支持该计划。

en: a feeling of nervousness or conflict
example: Tension between the two neighbours grew after the argument.
exampleZh: 争吵之后，两位邻居之间的紧张关系加剧了。

en: to rob a captured town or city
example: The soldiers threatened to sack the city if it refused to surrender.
exampleZh: 士兵们威胁说，如果这座城市拒绝投降，他们就洗劫它。

en: to grow well and be successful
example: Small shops can thrive when they offer something the big stores cannot.
exampleZh: 小店如果能提供大商店给不了的东西，就能兴旺发展。

en: severe and harmful, and hard to escape
example: A vicious circle of debt and borrowing ruined the small family farm.
exampleZh: 债务与借钱的恶性循环毁掉了这个家庭小农场。

en: based on ideas rather than practical experience
example: The plan sounds good, but its benefits are still purely theoretical.
exampleZh: 这个计划听起来不错，但它的好处仍然纯粹是理论上的。

en: extreme and far-reaching in effect
example: The owners rejected the most radical idea and kept the old oven.
exampleZh: 店主们否决了最激进的想法，保留了旧烤炉。

en: an advertising campaign to sell more of a product
example: The bakery's spring promotion brought many new customers into the shop.
exampleZh: 面包店的春季促销为店里带来了许多新顾客。

en: the joining of two companies into one
example: The merger with the coffee roaster saved both small businesses.
exampleZh: 与咖啡烘焙商的合并让两家小企业都活了下来。

en: a combination of ideas or things into a whole
example: Her report was a synthesis of interviews, sales data and staff opinions.
exampleZh: 她的报告综合了访谈、销售数据和员工意见。

en: the reporting of an event by newspapers or TV
example: The local paper gave the ferry breakdown wide coverage for a week.
exampleZh: 当地报纸对渡轮故障进行了一周的广泛报道。

en: working and ready to be used
example: Only one of the three ferries is fully operational this week.
exampleZh: 本周三艘渡轮中只有一艘能完全正常运营。

en: a feeling that someone or something deserves no respect
example: Many passengers felt the company had shown contempt for their safety.
exampleZh: 许多乘客觉得公司蔑视他们的安全。

en: the business of carrying goods by ship
example: The storm delayed shipping between the island and the mainland.
exampleZh: 暴风雨延误了岛与大陆之间的航运。

en: to charge someone with a crime in a court
example: The authority may prosecute the company for ignoring safety rules.
exampleZh: 主管部门可能会因公司无视安全规定而起诉它。

en: to send something along a different route

en: opposite to what is expected or stated
example: The afternoon was warm and sunny, contrary to the forecast.
exampleZh: 那天下午温暖晴朗，与预报相反。

en: a safe place from danger
example: The hikers took refuge in a farmhouse during the storm.
exampleZh: 暴风雨中，徒步者在一座农舍里避难。

en: the quality of not giving up
example: Her determination to finish the course impressed her teachers.
exampleZh: 她完成课程的决心给老师们留下了深刻印象。

en: a collection of someone's work or documents
example: He brought a portfolio of his drawings to the interview.
exampleZh: 他带着一本自己的画作集去参加面试。

en: the sending or spreading of something
example: The transmission of the disease was stopped by a simple vaccine.
exampleZh: 这种疾病的传播被一种简单的疫苗阻止了。

en: machines used for a particular job
example: Heavy machinery was needed to move the fallen rocks.
exampleZh: 需要重型机械来搬走落下的岩石。

en: a small paper or plastic container for goods
example: She opened a packet of biscuits and shared them with us.
exampleZh: 她打开一包饼干，和我们一起分着吃。

en: to look at something carefully
example: Officials came to inspect the kitchen before the restaurant opened.
exampleZh: 餐厅开业前，官员们来检查了厨房。

en: in the same order as the things already mentioned
example: Tom and Anna chose the red car and the blue one respectively.
exampleZh: 汤姆和安娜分别选了那辆红车和那辆蓝车。

en: a person or thing that gives you ideas or courage
example: Her grandmother's letters were a constant inspiration to her.
exampleZh: 祖母的信件一直给她鼓舞和灵感。

en: an animal hunted by another animal
example: The owl hunts its prey in almost complete darkness.
exampleZh: 猫头鹰在几乎完全黑暗的环境中捕猎。

en: while; during the time that
example: She read a book whilst waiting for the train.
exampleZh: 她一边等火车一边看书。

en: a formal agreement between countries
example: The two nations signed a peace treaty in 1945.
exampleZh: 两国于1945年签署了一项和平条约。

en: beliefs about what is right and wrong
example: The novel raises questions about morality and money.
exampleZh: 这部小说提出了关于道德与金钱的问题。

en: the basic laws that govern a country or group
example: The constitution protects freedom of speech.
exampleZh: 宪法保护言论自由。

en: the great size or importance of something
example: The magnitude of the damage became clear only after the storm.
exampleZh: 风暴过后，损失的严重程度才显现出来。

en: the act of admitting that something is true
example: Her admission that she had lost the key surprised everyone.
exampleZh: 她承认弄丢了钥匙，这让所有人都很惊讶。

en: a narrow path through the countryside
example: We followed the trail through the pine forest for two hours.
exampleZh: 我们沿着松林里的小路走了两个小时。

en: to guide or control the direction of something
example: She steered the small boat carefully around the rocks.
exampleZh: 她小心地驾着小船绕过礁石。

en: to become an expert in one particular area
example: He decided to specialize in children's medicine after his first year.
exampleZh: 第一年结束后，他决定专攻儿科医学。

en: a particular quality of a person or thing
example: Patience is a trait that every good teacher needs.
exampleZh: 耐心是每位好老师都需要的一种特质。

en: to think of or form an idea or plan
example: The team first conceived the project during a long train journey.
exampleZh: 团队最初是在一次长途火车旅行中构想出这个项目的。

en: a young person or child
example: A youngster from the next street won the drawing competition.
exampleZh: 隔壁街的一个孩子赢得了绘画比赛。

en: to show or describe something in a picture or in words
example: The painting depicts a quiet harbour at sunrise.
exampleZh: 这幅画描绘了日出时宁静的港湾。

en: to experience something unpleasant because of your actions
example: Drivers who park here may incur a heavy fine.
exampleZh: 在这里停车的司机可能会被处以高额罚款。

en: a person who spends time with you
example: My dog has been my closest companion for ten years.
exampleZh: 十年来，我的狗一直是我最亲密的伙伴。

en: allowed by the rules to do or receive something
example: Only students over eighteen are eligible for the scholarship.
exampleZh: 只有十八岁以上的学生才有资格申请这项奖学金。

en: the quality of being exact and accurate
example: The old clock was repaired with great precision.
exampleZh: 这座旧钟被非常精确地修好了。

en: the condition of being extremely overweight
example: Doctors link childhood obesity to sugary drinks and long screen time.
exampleZh: 医生认为儿童肥胖与含糖饮料和长时间看屏幕有关。

en: matching or connected to something else
example: Sales rose by ten percent, with a corresponding rise in profit.
exampleZh: 销售额增长了百分之十，利润也相应上升。

en: spoken rather than written
example: We had only a verbal agreement, so nothing was ever signed.
exampleZh: 我们只是口头约定，所以从未签过字。

en: the story of a person's life written by someone else
example: She is writing a biography of the town's first female doctor.
exampleZh: 她正在写这个镇第一位女医生的传记。

en: to let waste or liquid flow out
example: The factory must not discharge waste into the river.
exampleZh: 这家工厂不得向河中排放废料。

en: to appear as a large or worrying shape
example: Dark clouds loomed over the hills before the storm.
exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云笼罩着山丘。

en: something valuable that a person or place has
example: Her calm manner is a great asset in a busy office.
exampleZh: 在忙碌的办公室里，她的沉稳是一大优势。

en: a person who does not belong to a group
example: As an outsider, he noticed things the locals had stopped seeing.
exampleZh: 作为一个外人，他注意到了当地人已经视而不见的东西。

en: to delay something to a later time
example: They had to postpone the picnic because of the rain.
exampleZh: 因为下雨，他们不得不推迟野餐。

en: to build a strong relationship or agreement
example: The two schools forged a close partnership last year.
exampleZh: 这两所学校去年建立了紧密的合作关系。

en: an elected member of a local council
example: The councillor promised to raise the issue at the next meeting.
exampleZh: 这位议员承诺在下次会议上提出这个问题。

en: a system in which people are ranked by status
example: The company's hierarchy makes it hard for young staff to speak up.
exampleZh: 公司的等级制度让年轻员工很难大胆发言。

en: to take something important away from someone
example: The new road deprived the village of its quiet evenings.
exampleZh: 这条新路剥夺了村庄宁静的夜晚。

en: expensive or causing loss
example: Rebuilding the bridge turned out to be far more costly than planned.
exampleZh: 重建这座桥的代价远远超出计划。

en: by a large amount
example: The journey home took considerably longer than usual.
exampleZh: 回家的路程比平时多花了相当长的时间。

en: able to be believed
example: The witness gave a credible account of what happened that night.
exampleZh: 那位目击者对那晚发生的事做了可信的陈述。

en: the act of recording your name on an official list
example: Online registration for the course closes at the end of the week.
exampleZh: 这门课程的在线注册将于本周末截止。

en: energy that travels in waves or particles
example: Doctors use radiation to treat some kinds of cancer.
exampleZh: 医生用辐射治疗某些类型的癌症。

en: money paid to use a road or bridge
example: The toll for crossing the bridge rose again this year.
exampleZh: 今年过桥的通行费又涨了。

en: working hard for a purpose you care about
example: She is a dedicated teacher who stays late to help her students.
exampleZh: 她是一位尽心尽力的老师，常常留到很晚帮助学生。

en: the work of writing instructions for computers
example: He learned programming by building small games on his laptop.
exampleZh: 他通过在笔记本电脑上做小游戏学会了编程。

en: relating to a parent or parents
example: The school asked for parental permission before the trip.
exampleZh: 学校在出行前征求了家长的同意。

en: a lawyer who speaks for someone in court
example: Her attorney advised her not to sign the contract yet.
exampleZh: 她的律师建议她先不要签这份合同。

en: relating to a tribe or its people
example: The land is still governed by a tribal council of elders.
exampleZh: 这片土地仍由一个部落长老会管理。

en: to stay in someone's mind and trouble them
example: The memory of that night would haunt him for years.
exampleZh: 那一夜的记忆会在他心头萦绕多年。

en: stated clearly and in detail
example: The instructions were explicit about which door to use.
exampleZh: 说明中明确指出了该走哪扇门。

en: having enough skill to do something well
example: The team needs a competent manager who can handle pressure.
exampleZh: 这个团队需要一位能应对压力的称职经理。

en: a set of official rules for doing something
example: Staff followed the safety protocol before opening the case.
exampleZh: 工作人员在打开展柜前遵循了安全规程。

en: a period of work done as part of a course
example: She spent six months on a placement at a local museum.
exampleZh: 她在一家当地博物馆实习了六个月。

en: to include something as part of a whole
example: The new design will incorporate space for a small garden.
exampleZh: 新设计纳入了建造一个小花园的空间。

en: relating to living things and their environment
example: Restoring the marsh brought clear ecological benefits to the area.
exampleZh: 恢复湿地给该地区带来了明显的生态效益。

en: pressure or difficulty on a system or person
example: The dry summer put the city's water supply under strain.
exampleZh: 干旱的夏天使城市供水承受压力。

en: to care for young animals or children until they grow up
example: The reserve gives herons a safe place to rear their chicks.
exampleZh: 保护区为苍鹭提供了安全养育雏鸟的地方。

en: mainly; for the most part
example: The birds wintering here are predominantly young females.
exampleZh: 在这里过冬的鸟绝大多数是年轻的雌鸟。

en: a mathematical statement that two things are equal
example: She wrote an equation linking rainfall and the height of the river.
exampleZh: 她写了一个把降雨量与河水高度联系起来的方程式。

en: based on a set of political or social beliefs
example: The quarrel was ideological rather than practical.
exampleZh: 这场争执是观念上的，而不是实际层面的。

en: to organize people so they can act together
example: Volunteers began to mobilize as soon as the appeal went out.
exampleZh: 呼吁一发出，志愿者们就开始动员起来。

en: a person held prisoner until demands are met
example: The staff were held hostage for several hours.
exampleZh: 员工们被扣为人质长达数小时。

en: a row of people shown to a witness for identification
example: The witness picked the man out at a police line-up.
exampleZh: 目击者在警方的列队辨认中指认了那名男子。

en: to use up something such as money or energy
example: Medical bills can drain a family's savings in months.
exampleZh: 医疗账单能在几个月内耗尽一个家庭的积蓄。

en: used to describe repeated crimes by the same person
example: Detectives linked the three robberies to one serial offender.
exampleZh: 探员们把这三起抢劫案与同一名连环作案者联系起来。

en: to accept responsibility for a task and begin it
example: The neighbours agreed to undertake the repairs themselves.
exampleZh: 邻居们同意自己承担修缮工作。

en: a public service such as water or electricity
example: Rising utility bills forced the shop to cut its opening hours.
exampleZh: 不断上涨的公共事业账单迫使这家店缩短了营业时间。

en: a small sign that something existed or happened
example: The police found no trace of the missing car near the river.
exampleZh: 警方在河边没有找到失踪汽车的踪迹。

en: something that happens, especially something unusual
example: Power cuts were a rare occurrence in our neighbourhood last winter.
exampleZh: 去年冬天，我们街区很少停电。

en: to close something tightly so that nothing can get in or out
example: She sealed the envelope with tape before posting it.
exampleZh: 寄出之前，她用胶带把信封封好。

en: smaller or less important than another thing
example: The lesser details of the plan were left to the local team.
exampleZh: 计划的次要细节交给了当地团队处理。

en: not connected with religion
example: The school is secular and welcomes students of every faith.
exampleZh: 这所学校是世俗学校，欢迎各种信仰的学生。

en: a complete range of related things or qualities
example: The survey covered a wide spectrum of ages and incomes.
exampleZh: 这项调查涵盖了各个年龄段和收入水平。

en: producing money or financial gain
example: The small bakery became profitable after it started selling online.
exampleZh: 这家小面包店开始网上销售后变得有利可图。

en: a sudden violent explosion
example: The blast broke windows in houses across the street.
exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了街对面房屋的窗户。

en: never having happened before
example: The town saw unprecedented rainfall in a single afternoon.
exampleZh: 这座小镇在一个下午经历了前所未有的降雨。

en: the way parts of something are arranged together
example: The new configuration of the desks gave everyone more space.
exampleZh: 新的课桌布局给每个人都留出了更多空间。

en: the person someone is married to
example: Employees may bring a spouse to the annual dinner.
exampleZh: 员工可以携配偶参加年度晚宴。

en: a short job or paid performance
example: He picked up a weekend gig driving for a delivery company.
exampleZh: 他接了一份周末为快递公司开车的零工。

en: to notice something or think of it in a particular way
example: Many residents perceive the new park as a safe place for children.
exampleZh: 许多居民认为新公园是孩子们的安全场所。

en: the screen or system through which a user controls a device
example: The app's interface is clear enough for older users.
exampleZh: 这款应用的界面对年长用户来说足够清晰。

en: very strange or unusual
example: The film tells a bizarre story about a town where nobody sleeps.
exampleZh: 这部电影讲了一个离奇的故事，说有个小镇上没人睡觉。

en: a difference between two statements or facts that cannot both be true
example: There is a clear contradiction between his earlier letter and today's statement.
exampleZh: 他早先的信和今天的说法之间有明显矛盾。

en: a surprising fact that is made known
example: The diary's revelation about the mayor shocked the whole town.
exampleZh: 日记中关于市长的那一披露震惊了全镇。

en: sexual feelings, behaviour or identity
example: The course explores how ideas about sexuality changed during the last century.
exampleZh: 这门课程探讨过去一百年里人们对性的观念如何变化。

en: a large or dangerous animal
example: Villagers say a wild beast has been killing their sheep at night.
exampleZh: 村民们说有一头野兽夜里一直在咬死他们的羊。

en: without being affected or stopped by something
example: The match went ahead regardless of the heavy rain.
exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，比赛还是照常进行。

en: to look like or be similar to someone or something
example: The old building closely resembles a station I knew as a child.
exampleZh: 这座老建筑很像我小时候熟悉的一个车站。

en: a set of symptoms that often occur together
example: The doctor said the tiredness was part of a common syndrome.
exampleZh: 医生说这种疲倦是某种常见综合征的一部分。

en: to enter a place in large numbers and cause damage
example: Every spring, weeds invade the flower beds behind our house.
exampleZh: 每年春天，杂草都会侵占我们屋后的花坛。

en: protection given by a country to someone who has fled danger
example: The family applied for asylum after crossing the border on foot.
exampleZh: 这家人徒步越过边境后申请了庇护。

en: to begin something
example: The ceremony will commence at nine o'clock in the main hall.
exampleZh: 典礼将于九点在大礼堂开始。
